4. Can I change my card on file?
5. How do I reset my Recruit CRM password?
b: 1. Does Recruit CRM provide a free trial, and how long can I use the free trial? Yes, Recruit CRM offers a usage-based free trial , not a time-limited one. On the free plan, usage is counted even if records are deleted. ​ The free trial allows you to add: 50 Candidates 4 Jobs 50 Companies 50 Contacts Once these limits are reached, you’ll need to upgrade to a paid plan. On paid plans, deleting records frees up space. ​ You can sign up for a free trial using the link below: https://recruitcrm.io ​ 2. Can I log into Recruit CRM from multiple devices? Recruit CRM allows you to log in from: One laptop or desktop at a time The mobile app simultaneously Logging in from multiple laptops or desktops at the same time is not supported. Below are links to download our mobile apps: ​ iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/recruit-crm/id1532855707#?platform=iphone iPad: https://apps.apple.com/uz/app/recruit-crm/id1532855707#?platform=ipad Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.recruitcrm 3. Can I change my system language? Yes, Recruit CRM supports multiple system languages. Available options include: English French Dutch Spanish German Portuguese Japanese Finnish (Beta) Italian (Beta) Arabic (Beta) You can change the system language from your account settings. ​ The article below will help you set your system language: Changing the system language 4. Can I change my card on file? Yes, you can change your card on file with us at any time from the billing section in your admin settings. Check out the article below to learn how: Changing your card details on file with Recruit CRM 5. How do I reset my Recruit CRM password? Changing or resetting your Recruit CRM password is super easy. The article below will guide you to do so: Changing and resetting your Recruit CRM password 6. How do I add another license to my account and invite my teammate? To add another license to your account, please follow the steps below: Go to Admin Settings >>> Plans & Billing and then click on the " Edit Current Plan " button. ​ Increase the number of users by the number of users you want and click on "Review Order" and "Update Plan & Pay" ​ Once you do that, you'll then be charged for the additional seat that you bought for the remaining period of your billing cycle. Once this is done, go to Admin settings >>> Users to invite your teammates. ​ This article will help you with that . Here's a Webinar Registration form. You can have them fill up for a Webinar to train them on using Recruit CRM! ​ 7. Does Recruit CRM have a search functionality? Yes, Recruit CRM includes advanced search capabilities across all record types. You can use advanced filters and Boolean operators to find records based on specific keywords and conditions. ​ ​ Here is an article to help you do this: Advanced search filters boolean search 8. Where are all our data stored? Recruit CRM uses Amazon Web Services (AWS) for its infrastructure. For Pro and Business plans, data is stored and replicated across multiple AWS data centers, including regions in Ireland, Singapore, and the United States. ​ Data is automatically served from the nearest data center to reduce latency and improve uptime. ​ ​ Important note: Recruit CRM is fully GDPR compliant , with strict controls for global data handling and deletion. You can read our Data Processing Agreement & GDPR policy at the bottom of our website to confirm this. ​ ​ Here’s a link: ​ https://recruitcrm.io/legal/data-processing-agreement We ensure that we strictly adhere to GDPR rules for data globally, which includes deleting data across global data centers if requested by an end candidate or user of Recruit CRM. We specifically comply and have European SCCs (Standard contractual clauses) that are a framework to stay compliant while transferring data outside the EU for data processing. ​ You can learn more about this from the website below: For Enterprise customers, there is an option to set up a custom server or database in a specific AWS data center of your choice, such as Germany or Dublin. This setup is typically only required for organizations with specific regulatory or government-related data residency requirements within the EEA and is not mandatory for standard GDPR compliance. ​ 9. What are the features that are available on a Business Plan? The Business plan includes advanced features such as: 100 custom fields for all entities Phone Calling & Recording From Recruit CRM Texting feature for users in USA, UK, Israel, Canada & Sweden Creating Teams Of Users Within Recruit CRM Custom Roles - Access Control & Permissions In Recruit CRM API access Remove Recruit CRM Branding from External Pages CV/Resume Formatting Creating Multiple Hiring Pipelines Executive Summary Report Audit Logs Email Sequencing 2 Email connection LogicMelon Integration Broadbean Integration Single sign-on (SSO) AI Job-Candidate Matching Create and access templates for notes, call logs, and tasks These features support more advanced hiring workflows and reporting needs. ​ To upgrade, just go to the business plan from the Plans & Billing > Plans of your control panel! https://app.recruitcrm.io/billing/plans ​ More on the video below: https://www.loom.com/share/74f30d057cf54ecbafa33e0f2e19632b 10. How do I post my jobs on the free job boards? Posting Jobs on job boards is easy and seamless from Recruit CRM. When a job is created, ensure all the following conditions are satisfied so that the job is added to the feed: The Job-status should be "Open" The “Updated On” date should be within the last 30 days All the fields where you see the message "Required To Post On Partner Job Boards" (like City, State, Country, Job Application Form Link, currency, Maximum salary ) need to have a value. Make sure the "Post On Job Boards" option is selected inside Admin Settings >> Job Custom Fields . The job application form should be enabled; Once all criteria are satisfied, the job becomes eligible for posting on supported job boards. 11. How can I change the default owner of a candidate who applied via the talent pool? By default, candidates who apply through external pages are assigned to the account owner . There is currently no direct option to change this behavior. As a workaround, you can: Run an advanced search where the "source" is " Talent Pool" and bulk update the owner of those candidate records. 12. How many GB of storage do we get on RCRM? Each paid license includes 50 GB of storage per user . Total available storage increases with the number of licenses purchased. 13. I s there a way I can tell who has unsubscribed? Yes, you can do this using Advanced Search . Run an Advanced Search on the default Opt-out field If the value is Yes , the person has unsubscribed If the value is No , the person is still receiving emails ​ This allows you to clearly identify unsubscribed users. 14. How to find out if your jobs are being posted on the free job boards? Currently, there is no direct way inside Recruit CRM to check this. However, you can: Visit the free job boards directly Search for your jobs using the job title or company name This is the only way to confirm whether the jobs are being posted. 15. How can I check c andidates who are not a part of any hotlist ? Go to the Candidate list page Click on Quick View Select Not in any hotlist 16. When I give visibility to candidates within my job offers for the client, is there any way to see if they have accessed the candidates or not? Currently, there is no direct way to see whether the client has opened the link or viewed the candidates. ​ However you will receive a notification : Notification Trigger Notification Recipient(s) When the client opens ‘Online Candidate Link’ Job Owner Collaborator When client viewed the candidate profile via Online Candidate Link Job Owner Collaborator When Client downloads a candidate's Resume via Online Candidate Link Job Owner Collaborator You can check more in this article . 17. What is the Quick View section? The Quick View section is available on the list pages Candidates, Contacts, Jobs, Companies and Deals. ​ Although the layout differs slightly, the purpose remains the same across entities. On all of the Quick views, you will be able to see all of the records added by your account, as well as the records added by you, if they're on a specific hotlist as you will be able to search here, or if not in any hotlist. To access the quick view section just click on the Icon beside the "entity list name": Candidate Quick View contains: All candidates (all records) My candidates (you added to the system) All website applicants (all records who applied) My website applicants (people who applied to your jobs) Not in any hotlist Off-limits Candidates Contact and Company Quick View contains: All contacts/companies (all records) My contacts/companies (you added to the system) Not in any hotlist Off-limits contacts/companies Job Quick View contains: All jobs (all records) My jobs (you added to the syste

t: FAQ Handbook 2
s: All the most frequently asked questions about Recruit CRM
b: 1. How to add an updated CV/resume to the candidate profile ​ You can update a candidate’s resume in two ways, depending on whether you want to replace the existing resume or keep multiple versions. ​ Or if you want to add the updated CV to the files section, then 1. Go to the details page of any record (The image below is of a candidate's details page)-> click on files on the right side of the page. 2. Click on choose file -> select the file you want to upload -> click upload -> That's it! You can also just drag & drop the file. 2. Can we integrate the Calendly account with Recruitcrm/Recruit CRM/RCRM? ​ Yes, it is possible to integrate Calendly with Recruit CRM. ​ You can: Add your Calendly link to an email template and share it with candidates or contacts Include your Calendly link in your email signature Use Workflow Automation to automatically send Calendly links based on specific triggers Recruit CRM’s Workflow Automation is an add-on available across all plans (Free Trial, Pro, Business, and Enterprise). It allows you to automate actions between apps without coding and includes setup assistance and ongoing support. ​ Recruit CRM has an in-built automation tool called “ Workflow Automation ” that helps you automate repetitive tasks between two or more apps - no code necessary. ​﻿ ﻿Workflow Automation comes with an add-on subscription, which is separate from the standard Recruit CRM subscription, and is accessible to users across all Recruit CRM subscription plans (Free trial, Pro, Business, & Enterprise). ​﻿ ﻿With this, we brainstorm your ideas into workflows, help you set them up (or create them on your behalf if you prefer that), manage them on an ongoing basis, suggest best practices, and recommend automated workflows to help operate the business better, all of these no additional cost. ​ 3. When I go to replace a LinkedIn-made resume with a candidate's formal resume it keeps glitching and going back to the LinkedIn resume. Is there a way to fix this? ​ When replacing a LinkedIn-generated resume, make sure to: Click the trash icon to delete the existing resume first Upload the new resume Click the checkmark icon to confirm and save the change If the change is not confirmed using the checkmark, the system may revert to the previous resume. ​ ​ 4. Is there a way to send an automated email when we manually assign a different job to a candidate? ​ Yes, this can be done using Email Triggers . ​ The trigger activates each time a candidate is assigned to a job for the first time at a specific stage. ​ For example: Assigning a candidate to Customer Success Manager → email is sent Assigning the same candidate later to Marketing Manager → email is sent again The trigger is stage-based (for example, Assigned), so the email is sent when the candidate reaches that stage in a job. ​ 5. How long do we keep your data in? ​ If you cancel your account, data is retained for approximately 2 months in case you choose to return ​ If the account is fully deactivated, data is permanently deleted after 14 days. 6. I don't seem to have social media options when I put a job on. How can I have the social media icons on the job form? To display social media sharing icons on the job application form: Go to the Job Application Form settings Enable the option Show social media share icons Once enabled, the icons will appear on the job form. ​ 7. Aside from email triggers, do candidates get sent any automated emails from anywhere else in the system? ​ Yes. In addition to email triggers, candidates automatically receive Thank You for Applying emails (for job applicants and talent pool joiners if the email trigger is set up). Other automated or semi-automated emails can be sent manually or through Workflow Automation, including: Some examples: Job Details to Hotlist Candidates : Sends job details with the application URL to candidates in a specific job hotlist. ​ Post-Placement Follow-Up : Periodically checks the status of candidates' job experience after placement. Birthday Wishes : Sends automated birthday wishes annually. ​ GDPR Compliance : Manages candidate consent and profile updates. ​ Meeting reminders or meeting invites. ​ Bulk emails. 8. Error when trying to connect with LinkedIn ​ If you see an error such as “Access to this account has been restricted by the provider” while connecting LinkedIn: Try logging in using an Incognito/Private browser window , or Log out and log back in to trigger the authentication process again This usually resolves the issue. ​ 9. What actions will I receive a notification for inside the app? ​ Recruit CRM sends in-app notifications for the following actions: Apply to job Update resume Delete update-requested candidate Update candidate hiring status by contact Email opened Import Add candidate from the Talent Pool Merge duplicates Enroll in a sequence Mark candidate as available Added as collaborator to deal Record available (company, contact, candidate) Record marked off-limits (company, contact, candidate) File export Geocoding ​ 10. We realize that when we add candidates to the system, the companies they work for automatically get added into the system too. Can we turn off this feature? ​ Yes, this can be disabled by default: A candidate’s current organization is automatically added as a company if it doesn’t exist. If a matching company is found, the candidate is linked to it. If no match is found, the organization is stored as plain text. If you don't want the candidate's current organization to be added to your database while sourcing candidates through LinkedIn, you can disable the feature in the Account Settings: Only the account owner will be able to manage the settings: ​ 11. When entering a note for a log call, is there a system that automatically saves a draft of the note/notes in case I lost it or by mistake closed it? ​ Currently, there is no automatic draft-saving for notes or call logs. However: Refreshing the page usually retains the last entered content. Closing the page or losing the session will result in the note being lost. ​ 12. When importing candidates, how can I make sure the fields on the sheet/doc I have a match with the system? ​ Recruit CRM supports the following candidate default fields during import apart from these fields if you have any of the columns that are not available then you need to create custom fields for those columns so that you can import the records: Candidate First Name Candidate Last Name Email Phone Total Experience Relevant Experience Current Salary Current Organization Skills Willing to Relocate Salary Expectation Title / Position Full Address City Locality State Country Currency Facebook Profile Twitter Profile Linkedin Profile Github Profile Xing Profile Source Current Employment Status Notice Period (Days) Available From Salary Type Language Skills Availability Note Off-Limit Status 13. Is there any way to make a contact out of a candidate or a candidate out of a contact that was added on the wrong place? ​ Yes, this can be done in two ways. ​ Option 1: ​ Use Link Candidates & Contacts That Are the Same Person to create or connect profiles. ​ ​ Option 2: Export the candidate or contact from the list page and re-import the CSV file into the correct entity. ​ Click on Exporting Data To Excel/CSV feature so then after exporting you can simply import the CSV file again with that candidate or contact into the system on the right place. ​ 14. Is it possible to view the notes about a candidate when clicking on their CV from a candidate search? ​ Yes. When you open a candidate’s resume: You can click the Add Note button This opens a side panel where you can add a new note At the same time, all previously added notes are visible in the lower section of the panel. This allows you to view the resume and notes simultaneously . ​ ​ 15. If I/we don't use all the WA (Workflow Automation) tasks in a month do they roll over to the next month? ​ No, unused Workflow Automation tasks do not roll over to the next month. Workflow Automation is an add-on that provides a fixed number of tasks per month , depending on the plan/bucket you have selected . The add-on can be billed monthly or annually , but regardless of the billing cycle, the tasks are reset every month . 16. How can I filter on the candidate's screen for all placed candidates? ​ The easiest way to view all placed candidates is through the Dashboard . Go to Total Candidates Statistics Click on the Placed stage This will display all candidates who are currently marked as placed. ​ 17. I'm not able to see the whole CV/download the CV or see any other buttons like the Admin settings on your screen on the system ​ This is usually related to screen zoom settings . ​ Please check and adjust the zoom level on your computer or browser, as excessive zooming can hide buttons or sections of the interface. ​ 18. What tool is used for building the AI Assist on RCRM ? ​ Recruit CRM uses OpenAI’s GPT models via API , specifically GPT-4

t: Favicon in Recruit Craft
s: This article will help you understand what a favicon is and how to add or update it for your website.
h: How to upload a favicon
Removing a Favicon
b: A favicon is the small icon that represents your website and appears in the browser address bar. It helps visitors quickly recognize your site, improves brand visibility, and gives your careers page a polished and professional look. A favicon also makes your website easier to identify when multiple tabs are open and helps it appear more recognizable and trustworthy in browser tabs and search results. ​ 🖼️ How to upload a favicon All Recruit Craft users can upload and manage a favicon directly from the Settings section. Go to the Settings panel on your left and click on the Favicon option. ​ ​ Upload your favicon file by clicking on the Upload Favicon button. ​ Supported formats and size When uploading a favicon, make sure it meets the following requirements: Supported formats - ico, png, gif, or jpg Recommended size - 32 x 32 pixels Maximum file size allowed - 30 KB Using the correct size and format ensures the favicon displays properly across browsers. 4. Once uploaded, you can also preview how the favicon will appear in the browser address bar. This helps you confirm that the icon looks clear and aligns with your brand. ​ You can update or replace your favicon at any time by repeating these steps. Once updated, the new favicon will automatically reflect on your website and in the browser address bar. ​ ❌ Removing a Favicon If you no longer want to use a favicon, you can remove it easily from the settings. Go to Settings in Recruit Craft. Locate the favicon section. Click on the Remove button. ​ Once removed, the favicon will no longer appear in the browser address bar. ​ I hope this helps! t: Field visibility and rearrangement/reorder of columns on list page
s: This article will guide you around arranging fields in your preferred order.
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
Step-by-step instructions on how to customize the field arrangement
How to set up a default field arrangement for the entire account?
Troubleshooting
Problem: I can’t change the column order or visibility.
FAQs
Does changing my column visibility affect other users?
Conclusion:
b: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM allows you to customize and arrange the fields (for Candidates / Companies / Contacts / Jobs) in the List View in any way you want! Field visibility and column reordering let you control which fields appear as columns on list pages and in what order they appear from left to right. ​ You can use this feature when: You want to quickly see the most important information on your list pages. Use it when you want to organize your list view for better efficiency, focus on important fields, or reduce clutter by hiding unnecessary columns. 📋 Step-by-step instructions on how to customize the field arrangement Please note that only users with the appropriate permissions will be able to edit the column/field arrangement. Click here to learn more. 1. Go to the Candidates / Companies / Contacts / Jobs list page, depending on which records you want to customize. ​ 2. On the top-right of the list page, click on the Pencil icon to open the column settings panel and view all fields that are available in your database. 3. Now tick the fields you want to make visible on the List page. The fields will be divided in 'Visible Columns' and 'Hidden Columns'. You can also quickly find the fields using the search bar. Click here to learn more about field visibility 4. You can rearrange the order of the fields by dragging the field up or down and by clicking on Apply. That's it. Your column order will reflect immediately! How to set up a default field arrangement for the entire account? If you are the Account Owner you can set up a default column arrangement on the Candidate/Contact's List Page for all users in the account. ​ While editing the visibility of the columns, you'll have the option to switch to "Others View". All changes you make in this view will apply to all the users in your account. If you wish to enforce the column arrangement and prevent the users from having a different setup, you can simply turn on the toggle. This will ensure that the account owner's column arrangement remains the same for all users in the account. Users with an Admin role or custom permissions will still be able to rearrange the column even if the toggle is on. ​ If you're creating/editing a custom role, you just need to make sure to enable the "Allow User to Choose their Own Field Order and Visibility" ​ You can also create custom fields from the Admin Settings for all entities (Candidate / Company / Contact / Jobs) and add them to the List View. Troubleshooting Problem: I can’t change the column order or visibility. t: Filter types for Advanced Search
s: Learn about the various filters types available within Recruit CRM, their function and usage.
h: What this feature does & when to use it?
Step-by-step instructions
Understand Record Fields vs Activity Fields
FAQs
Conclusion:
b: What this feature does & when to use it? Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can use this feature when: You want to narrow down large lists of candidates, contacts, companies, or jobs. You need to find records that match (or exclude) specific keywords, locations, or skills. You’re combining Boolean search with field-level filters for more precise results. You’re analysing activities (notes, calls, tasks, meetings) linked to your records. You want to quickly identify records with empty or filled-in fields. Step-by-step instructions Open the Add Filters in Recruit CRM’s to access the full list of filter types you can apply to your search criteria. Use the “ Is ” Filter for Exact Matches of a keyword. The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword. You can use it to find all the candidates who are located in a specific state or city, and it will exactly match the word you're searching for. Example, you can search for all the candidates located in Delhi using the Is filter. ​ Use the “ Is not ” Filter to Exclude Values . The Is not filter excludes records that do not fit a certain set of criteria. You might use the Is not filter to remove candidates who do not meet a particular requirement. For example, you could use the Is not filter to find any candidates who are not specified in a skill set. ​ ​ The Contains filter helps identify partial Keyword Matches. The Contains filter identifies records containing a specific keyword or criteria. For example, you could search for all candidates who have the word marketing in their resume using the Contains filter. ​ ​ Use the “ Does not contain ” Filter to Omit Keywords. The Does not contain filter allows you to search for records that don't have a specific word or criteria. For example, you could search for contacts that don't have the title of manager. ​ ​ Use the “ Contains Exact Word ” Filter for Precise Word Matches. This filter looks for the exact word you enter, but allows it to appear anywhere within the field as a standalone word. Unlike the regular Contains filter, it will not return results where the keyword is part of a larger word. For example, if you search for “Shravya” using the Contains Exact Word filter, it will return results like “Shravya Verma” or “Shravya M”, but will exclude variations where the word is embedded within another term or formatted differently. ​ ​ Use the “ Contains at least one ” Filter for Multiple Keywords. Use this filter to find records that match at least one keyword from a list. For example, you could search for all candidates who have either marketing or accounting skills using the Contains at least one filter. ​ ​ Use the “ Begins with ” Filter for Starting Text Begins with the specific keyword. The Begins with filter finds records starting with a keyword or a phrase. For example, you can search for all jobs that begin with the word product using the Begin with filter. ​ ​ Use the “ Ends with ” Filter for Ending Text Ends with a specific keyword. Use this filter to find records ending with a specific keyword. For example, you could search for all jobs that ends with the word manager using the Ends with filter. ​ ​ Use the “ Has any value ” Filter for Non-Empty Fields that have any value. Use this filter to find records where the selected field is not empty. ​ ​ Use the “ Is empty ” Filter and Apply Your Filters. You can use the Is empty filter to search for records that have the specific field selected as empty, and then click on Apply to save these changes and save the filter and use it. Now that you know everything about filter types, you should try to run a search. ​ Understand Record Fields vs Activity Fields Across all entities, filters are broadly divided into two main categories. One is record fields. These are core details of records like candidate, company, contact, or job. And the second is activity fields such as notes, calls, tasks, and meetings. Each activity type can be further filtered using added on, updated on, added by, or updated by the type associated with, collaborated with, and whether it exists or not. FAQs How is “Is” different from “Contains” in Advanced Search? The Is filter looks for an exact match of a keyword in the selected field, while Contains finds records where the keyword appears anywhere in that field, even as part of a longer phrase. Can I combine Boolean search with these filter types? Yes. Recruit CRM's advanced search feature lets you combine a powerful Boolean search with column-level filters. You can run a Boolean query and then refine the results using filters like Is , Contains , Is empty , and more. Conclusion: Using the right filter types in Recruit CRM’s Advanced Search helps you quickly narrow down large datasets, find exactly the records you need, and spot gaps or patterns in your data. s: This article walks you through different ways to find and access data, whether through collections, search, or databases.
h: Step-by-step instructions on how to find Data Sources
How to Explore Data?
More Information on Columns
Find Questions and Dashboards
Troubleshooting
Conclusion:
b: The easiest way to explore data in Advanced Analytics is by looking at dashboards and charts that your teammates have already created. Step-by-step instructions on how to find Data Sources If you prefer to explore data directly from source tables, you can browse available databases. To browse databases and tables: 1.Open the left sidebar and go to Browse → Databases . 2.Select the Recruit CRM database. 3.View all tables within the database (e.g., Calllog, Deals, Candidates ). Recruit CRM provides a structured way to manage recruitment data through various entities like Candidates , Contacts , Jobs , Deals , Call Logs , and more. Each of these entities holds essential information that helps recruiters streamline their workflow, track progress, and make informed decisions. How to Explore Data? Each entity allows you to drill down into detailed records and analyze specific data points. By clicking on an entity, you can: View detailed information about records. Filter and search based on different attributes. Track changes and updates over time. More Information on Columns For a detailed breakdown of the column structure for each entity, including the meaning of different fields, please check out this article . Find Questions and Dashboards 1. Browse Collections Collections in Advanced Analytics work like folders, storing dashboards and charts . You can find them in the left navigation sidebar . To access a collection: 1.Open the left sidebar (click ☰ if it’s hidden). 2.Click on a collection (e.g., Shared Collection 662 ). Inside, you’ll see: Pinned Dashboards (e.g., "Default Dashboard" & "Client Requirements Dashboard") – for quick access. ​ Other Items – charts, reports, or additional Collections. Tip: You can pin important dashboards and create subcollections to stay organized. 2. Use Search to Find Data Search will look through names, descriptions, and metadata of your questions and dashboard. If you already have an idea of what you're looking for (e.g., "total deals per recruiter"), type Keyword in Search box to quickly locate dashboards, questions, or tables. To search for data: 1.Click on Search (top-right of the screen). 2.Type a keyword (e.g., "deals" ). Advanced Search: 1.Click " View and filter all results " to refine your search. 2.Filter by content type (questions, dashboards), creator, or other options. Summary You can find data in Advanced Analytics in two ways: Browse collections: View existing questions and dashboards. Browse Databases & Tables: Explore raw data from available sources. Troubleshooting Problem: The left navigation panel shows "An error occurred," collections or navigation items fail to load, collections appear missing, or new dashboards/collections/questions cannot be created. Likely cause: A browser ad blocker or content blocker is preventing one or more API requests required to populate the sidebar and load or create collection data. What to check: Verify whether an ad blocker or content blocker is enabled. Confirm whether Personal Collections and Shared Collections are visible. Check whether creating a new dashboard, collection, or question results in an infinite loading spinner. Resolution path: Disable the browser's ad blocker or content blocker and refresh the Metabase page. Verify that the sidebar loads correctly, collections are visible, and dashboards, collections, and questions can be created successfully. Note: If you're using Arc Browser, its built-in content blocker can cause this issue even with other ad blockers disabled. Disable Arc's built-in blocker specifically for the Metabase site, then reload the page. Conclusion: Whether you start from existing dashboards and collections or browse raw database tables directly, Advanced Analytics gives you multiple paths to locate the data you need. Using Search alongside collections makes it faster to find the right question, dashboard, or table without digging manually. If you need help at any stage, feel free to reach out to Recruit CRM support for further assistance. Hope this helps! t: Fonts Deprecation for Unified User Experience
s: This article outlines the deprecation of non-web-safe fonts on Recruit CRM and how this change improves consistency and compatibility.
h: Why we deprecated non-web-safe fonts
List of Deprecated Fonts
What Does This Mean for You?
How to Use Non-Web-Safe Fonts
Considerations for non-web-safe fonts in the source code
How operating systems, devices or browsers affect the font:
b: To enhance font consistency across browsers and devices, we've removed non-web-safe fonts from our app. This ensures that content appears as intended, regardless of where it's viewed, improving the overall user experience for both you and your prospects. 🤔 Why we deprecated non-web-safe fonts Non-web-safe fonts like Calibri, Roboto, Montserrat, and others often render differently across devices, operating systems, and browsers. This inconsistency can lead to situations where you see one font, but your candidates and clients see another. By standardizing the use of web-safe fonts, such as Arial, Times New Roman, and Verdana , we ensure content is displayed uniformly for all users. Inconsistent font rendering can negatively affect the professionalism and readability of your communications, whether it's an email, job description, or other content. 📋 List of Deprecated Fonts Calibri Calibri-Light Ink-Free Roboto Proxima-Nova Ronnia Montserrat Open Sans Comic-Sans Lucida What Does This Mean for You? Editor Fonts: These deprecated fonts are no longer available directly in our text editors. However, you can still use them by manually adding the font in the source code. Existing Templates: If you have existing email templates using non-web-safe fonts, those will remain unchanged. Emails sent from those templates will continue to display in the selected font style. 🔐 How to Use Non-Web-Safe Fonts Although these fonts have been removed from the editor, you can still use them if needed by following these steps: Access the source code of your content. Manually add the desired non-web-safe font from the list above. Keep in mind, that users viewing the content on devices or browsers that do not support the font may see an alternate font. For more detailed instructions, refer to our article on customizing fonts in Recruit CRM. ⚠️ Considerations for non-web-safe fonts in the source code How operating systems, devices or browsers affect the font: When content is delivered/accessed, the operating system, browser, or device checks if the specified font is available. If not, it substitutes it with a font that is similar to the one available. For example, using fonts like Calibri, Ink-Free, or Proxima-Nova may cause your content to display differently depending on the viewer's device or browser. This can affect readability and the overall presentation of your content. To avoid such issues, we highly recommend sticking to web-safe fonts like Arial, Courier New, Georgia, and Tahoma for maximum consistency. t: Generate Sequence using AI
s: Build multi-step, multi-channel outreach sequences for candidates and contacts in minutes using AI.
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
Step-by-Step Instructions
Step 1: Open the Sequence Creation Form
Step 2: Write a Detailed Prompt
Step 3: Review the Generated Sequence
Step 4: Regenerate the Sequence or Individual Steps
Step 5: Edit, Extend, and Finalize the Sequence.
All AI-generated steps are fully editable. Before saving, you can:
b: What this feature does and when to use it? AI sequence generation in Recruit CRM lets you create complete, multi-step outreach sequences for candidates or contacts without drafting each step manually. You describe your goal, target audience, desired tone, and any specific requirements in a single prompt, and the AI generates a ready-to-review sequence of up to six steps. Each sequence can include email steps, SMS steps (if applicable), task steps, and, where the LinkedIn add-on is enabled, LinkedIn steps as well. You can regenerate the full sequence or individual steps, edit any generated content, and add further steps manually before saving and enrolling records. You can use this feature when: You want to quickly create a structured outreach sequence for candidates or contacts. You need a multi-step, multi-channel workflow that includes emails, tasks, and LinkedIn actions. You want AI to draft the initial sequence steps so you can review, refine, and deploy them faster. Important Note: We use ChatGPT to power the AI sequence generation, which is still undergoing improvements. As a result, the AI-generated content may sometimes be inaccurate or misleading. Please ensure you always double-check the results for accuracy. Step-by-Step Instructions Step 1: Open the Sequence Creation Form Navigate to the Sequences page in Recruit CRM from the Admin Settings. Choose whether you are creating a sequence for Candidates or Contacts . Click Create Sequence Using AI to open the AI prompt interface. Step 2: Write a Detailed Prompt The quality of the AI-generated sequence depends directly on the quality of your prompt. A detailed, specific prompt produces a more accurate and personalized result than a short or vague one. Your prompt should include as many of the following as relevant: Goal and use case: What is this sequence trying to achieve? For example, outreach for a new job opening, follow-up after a career fair, or a product demo invitation. Target audience: Who will receive this sequence? For example, mid-level software engineers, HR managers at enterprise companies, or passive candidates in a specific industry. Desired tone: How should the messages feel? For example, professional, warm and conversational, concise and direct, or persuasive. Language: Specify the language if you need the sequence in a language other than English. If your prompt is written in Spanish, the sequence will be generated in Spanish. Specific requirements: Any particular points to include, links to mention, actions to prompt, or content to avoid. 💡 Tips for better prompts: The more detail you provide, the more accurately the AI can tailor the sequence to your needs. If you prefer to speak rather than type, click the microphone icon to dictate your prompt using voice input. Always skim the transcribed text before clicking Send to catch any speech recognition errors. Example prompt: "Create a five-step outreach sequence in English for passive software engineering candidates being considered for a senior backend role at a fintech startup. Use a professional but approachable tone. Include two follow-up emails, one LinkedIn connection request, and one task to call the candidate." Click Send (arrow icon) after entering or dictating your prompt. The AI will process your input and generate the sequence. Step 3: Review the Generated Sequence Once the AI has finished generating, a sequence of up to six steps will appear. These may include email steps, task steps, and LinkedIn steps if your account has the LinkedIn add-on enabled. Review each step carefully before proceeding. 📌 Note: Six steps is the default maximum for AI generation. If your workflow requires more than six steps, add them manually after reviewing the generated output or you can mention the required steps in the prompt itself. Step 4: Regenerate the Sequence or Individual Steps If you are not satisfied with the output, you have two regeneration options: Regenerate the full sequence: Click the global Regenerate button to discard the current output and generate a completely new sequence from your prompt. ​ Regenerate a specific step: Click the Regenerate button on an individual step card to regenerate only that step while keeping the rest of the sequence intact. ​ Step 5: Edit, Extend, and Finalize the Sequence. All AI-generated steps are fully editable. Before saving, you can: Click into any generated step to edit its subject line, body text, timing, or any other field. Add new steps manually by scrolling to the bottom of the sequence and selecting a step type: Email , Task , SMS or LinkedIn (where available). Reorder steps or adjust timing between steps to match your preferred cadence. ⚠️ Important: If you have already added steps manually and then choose to use Create Sequence Using AI , a warning will appear stating that the AI-generated steps will overwrite all existing manually added steps. Proceed only if you are comfortable losing those steps. There is no automatic rollback, so consider saving a copy of the sequence before making major changes. ​ Step 6: Save and Enroll Records Once you have reviewed and finalized all steps, click Save to store the sequence. Enroll the relevant candidates or contacts into the sequence to begin outreach. Generating LinkedIn Steps with AI When the LinkedIn Messages Integration add-on is enabled on your account, the AI can include LinkedIn connection requests and message steps alongside email and task steps within the same generated sequence. This enables a complete multi-channel outreach workflow from a single prompt. 📌 LinkedIn step requirements: The LinkedIn Messages Integration add-on must be active on your account for LinkedIn steps to appear in AI-generated sequences. All AI-generated LinkedIn steps are fully editable before saving, so you can adjust messaging, timing, and connection request notes to match your strategy. Click here to learn more about Email Sequencing in Recruit CRM Click here to learn more about LinkedIn message sequencing in Recruit CRM Click here to learn more about SMS Sequencing in Recruit CRM Troubleshooting Problem - The AI-generated content doesn’t match your desired tone or audience. Likely cause : The prompt is too short or not specific enough. ​ What to check : Review your prompt to see if it clearly states goal, audience, tone, language, and any special requirements. ​ Resolution path : Update the prompt with more detail and click Send again, or use the Regenerate buttons on the sequence or individual steps. Problem - Generated content appears misleading or factually incorrect. Likely cause : Limitations of the underlying ChatGPT model. ​ What to check : Carefully review each AI-generated step for accuracy and relevance. ​ Resolution path : Manually edit the content in each step to correct inaccuracies before saving and enrolling records. Avoid using AI-generated text without human review. FAQs Can I edit the AI-generated sequences? Yes, users can edit and customize the AI-generated sequences before finalizing them. Is there support for multiple languages? Yes, it supports multiple languages based on user prompts. For example, if your prompt is in Spanish, the sequence steps will be generated in Spanish. Is there a limit to the use of this feature? Yes, the AI-Assist feature has monthly token limits that vary based on your plan. Token usage includes both input and output, and may vary depending on the language and content. ​ Please note that token counts may vary based on the language and content. Monthly token limits per user: • Free Plan – 50K tokens • Pro Plan – 5 million tokens • Business Plan – 10 million tokens • Enterprise Plan – 20 million tokens These limits apply to the following AI features: • Generate Note Summary • Generate Call Log Summary • Generate Email Template • Generate Email • Generate Email Sequence • Email Reply Suggestion • Generate Candidate Summary • Generate Job Description Note: These token limits currently do not apply to AI Sourcing and AI Boolean Search . Can I edit AI-generated steps before enrolling candidates or contacts? Yes. All AI-generated steps (emails, tasks, SMS, LinkedIn) are fully editable. You should review and adjust each step before saving the sequence and enrolling records. Conclusion: Using AI to generate sequences in Recruit CRM lets you quickly build structured, multi-channel outreach for candidates and contacts while keeping full control over the final content. Provide a clear prompt, review and refine each step, and then save and enroll your records to put your new sequence into action. Generating Microsoft Teams links while creating meetings 1. Open the candidate or contact record you want to schedule a meeting with. 2. Click Add Meeting from either: The Activities section on the right, or The Assigned Jobs widget next to the respective candidate details. 3. Generate a Microsoft Teams link from the Chrome extension 1. On the Recruit CRM Chrome extension, after saving the candidate/contact you can add a meeting as well: The candidate/contact will then receive the confirmation email and they can join the meeting right from their email. Please note: The description box and the link are adjusted to the system language set by you in the profile settings . What to check: Confirm that your calendar is integrated and that the Microsoft Teams integration in calendar settings shows as connected. Resolution: Go to your profile’s calendar settings, scroll to the Microsoft Teams integration, click Connect , choose your account, and allow access. FAQs Where does the Microsoft Teams link appear in the meeting details? The Microsoft Teams link appears in the Where section. Does the candidate or contact receive the Microsoft Teams link by email? Yes, if you choose to send the confirmation email when adding the meeting, the email will include the meeting details, the Microsoft Teams link, and your description. Conclusion: By connecting your Microsoft organizational account and Outlook calendar to Recruit CRM, you can generate Microsoft Teams links directly while scheduling meetings, ensuring candidates and contacts receive clear, join-ready invitations. s: This article will help you Sign up and connect Recruit Craft with Recruit CRM.
h: Signing up on Recruit Craft

b: Whether you're a recruiter, a talent acquisition pro, or just someone looking to build an impressive recruitment experience, Recruit Craft gives you all the tools you need without any technical skills required. Let’s walk you through how to sign up and get started! 🔑 Signing up on Recruit Craft 1. When you land on the homepage of Recruit Craft , click on the “Get Started Free” button if you’re signing up for the first time and want to try it out on our Free Trial account. If you already have an account, just hit Sign In. You can also sign up from the login page, just find the “Sign Up” option right there at the bottom. 2. Once on the Sign Up page, you’ll be asked to enter a few important details like your name, your company name, email address, and a password. Be sure to use a valid email address, as a verification link will be sent to it shortly. 3. Once you’ve submitted your details, head to your inbox and look for an email from Recruit Craft. Open it and click on the verification button inside. That’s it! Your email gets verified, and you’ll be automatically logged into your new account. 🔗 Connecting Recruit Craft to your Recruit CRM account To display your jobs from Recruit CRM on Recruit Craft, it's essential to connect the two platforms. This connection acts as a bridge, allowing job listings from your Recruit CRM account to flow into your Recruit Craft workspace seamlessly. Once the integration is set up, you won’t need to manually copy or update job details as everything will stay in sync automatically, making your hiring process smoother and more efficient. Follow along to connect your Recruit CRM account to Recruit Craft. 1. Click on your profile icon in the bottom left corner of your Recruit Craft dashboard. From the dropdown menu, select Settings . 2. Once you're inside the Settings section, look at the panel on the left side of your screen. Click on Connect API to access your integration options. 3. You’ll now need to switch over to your Recruit CRM account to retrieve your API key . Once copied, return to Recruit Craft, paste the key into the provided field, and click Sync Jobs to complete the connection. Once saved, your Recruit CRM account is successfully connected to Recruit Craft. You’ll now see all your open jobs directly in Recruit Craft’s job preview section Know more about the Recruit CRM API Documentation For your jobs to be visible in Recruit Craft, please ensure the following conditions are met: The job status must be set to Open. The job application form must be enabled. If both of these requirements are fulfilled, the job will be fetched and displayed in Recruit Craft. You now have access to all the major features Recruit Craft has to offer. Explore our professionally designed templates, customize them to match your brand, and start building a career or job page that truly stands out. There’s plenty more to discover, so take your time, experiment, and make it your own. Happy recruiting and happy exploring! 😊 Related Articles Getting Started with Recruit CRM Recruit Craft: No-Code Career Page & Candidate Portal Builder Pricing and Billing in Recruit Craft Recruit Craft Website Builder How Google for Jobs Works With Your Recruit Craft Career Page

Problem: My emails are not contributing to the Sent Email Conversation KPI in team performance reports.
FAQs
b: What this feature does and when to use it? The Hide Your Emails feature allows you to keep your email conversations with candidates and contacts private from other users on your Recruit CRM account. When enabled, emails associated with your connected mailbox are removed from the Related Emails tab and are excluded from the Sent Email Conversation KPI in Team Performance Reports . These email conversations remain visible only within your personal mailbox in Recruit CRM. The setting applies to both past and future emails associated with the mailbox while it remains enabled. When disabled, previously hidden emails automatically become visible again in the Related Emails tab, and past email visibility is updated retroactively to reflect the new setting. This feature is especially useful when: • You want to keep your email conversations with candidates or contacts private from other team members. • You need to restrict access to email communication for confidentiality or compliance reasons. Please Note: The Hide Your Emails feature will hide all your email conversations in the Related Email tab. If you choose to hide your emails, you and your teammates will not be able to see any of the emails with candidates/contacts. Step-by-step instructions Turn on Hide Your Emails: Click your profile picture at the top right corner. Select Email Settings from the menu to open your email configuration page. Ensure your email account is connected to Recruit CRM. If your email is not connected, connect it first to access this setting. In Email Settings, locate the Hide Emails toggle. If you have multiple email accounts connected, choose whether you want to hide conversations from all connected email accounts or from a specific email address only. ​ ​ 📌 Please note: Multiple email connections are available on the Business plan and above. ​ Turn on the Hide Emails toggle to hide your email conversations. Turn off Hide Your Emails: Go back to Email Settings from your profile menu. Find the Hide Emails toggle. Turn the toggle off to deactivate the Hide Your Emails feature. Once deactivated, all previously hidden emails will automatically reappear in the Related Emails tab on associated records, and will again contribute to relevant email metrics. Troubleshooting Problem: I do not see the Hide Your Emails toggle in Email Settings. Likely cause: Your email is not connected. ​ ​ What to check: •Open Email Settings and verify that at least one email address is connected. ​ ​ Resolution: •Connect your email to Recruit CRM, then reopen Email Settings to access the Hide Your Emails toggle. •If you still cannot see it, contact your account administrator or Recruit CRM support to confirm feature availability for your plan. Problem: My emails are not contributing to the Sent Email Conversation KPI in team performance reports. Likely cause: The Hide Your Emails feature is turned on for your mailbox. ​ ​ What to check: •Open Email Settings and verify the status of the Hide Emails toggle. ​ ​ Resolution: •Turn off the Hide Emails toggle if you want your emails to count toward the Sent Email Conversation KPI and appear in team performance reports. FAQs What happens to existing emails when I enable Hide Your Emails? When you enable Hide Your Emails, all existing and future email conversations with candidates and contacts linked to your connected mailbox are hidden from the Related Emails tab and removed from the Sent Email Conversation KPI. They remain visible only in your personal mailbox in Recruit CRM. Who can configure the Hide Your Emails setting? Each user can configure the Hide Your Emails setting for their own connected mailbox in Email Settings . This setting is applied per user, not globally for the entire account. Can my teammates see my hidden emails anywhere in Recruit CRM? No. When Hide Your Emails is enabled, your email communication with candidates and contacts is not visible to you or your teammates in the Related Emails tab or in the Sent Email Conversation KPI. It is visible only in your personal mailbox in the Recruit CRM. Conclusion: Using the Hide Your Emails feature in Recruit CRM, you can control exactly who sees your email conversations with candidates and contacts while still working from your integrated mailbox. If you need further help configuring or understanding this setting, please reach out to your account administrator or Recruit CRM support. Once enabled, an icon will appear providing quick access to view all hotlists associated with each respective record. Additionally, you can run an advanced search based on the hotlist column. 4. Remove Candidates from a Hotlist Navigate to the desired hotlist. Select the record that you want to remove. Click on the Remove from Hotlist button from the header bar under the More tab. 5. Export Candidates from a Hotlist Open the required hotlist. Select the candidates within a hotlist that you want to export. Click on the Export button from the header bar under the More tab. This will export the selected candidates according to your export configuration. 6. Delete Candidates from Your Database via a Hotlist If you wish to delete a candidate from your database, you can delete them from inside a hotlist as well. Please note that once you delete any candidate, they will be permanently deleted from your database. 7. However, if you are in the business plan, you can create a custom role with permission to edit the hotlist owned by the other teammates. Likely cause: You do not have permission to edit or delete that hotlist. What to check: Confirm whether you are the account owner, the hotlist owner, or on a custom role with edit/delete permission. Also, check your plan (Business or otherwise) and your role permissions. Resolution path: Ask your admin or account owner to grant you a custom role with permission to edit or delete the hotlist owned by other teammates. If you are not on a plan that supports this, request the hotlist owner or account owner to make the changes or delete it. Problem: Candidates still appear in your database after deleting a hotlist. Likely cause: Deleting a hotlist does not delete the records inside the hotlist. What to check: Confirm whether you deleted only the hotlist or also deleted candidates via the hotlist. Resolution path: If you want to delete candidates, open the hotlist, select the candidates, and click on the Delete button under the More tab. Remember this permanently deletes them from your database. FAQs 1. Can I search or filter hotlists? Yes. You can further streamline your hotlist management by utilizing the search bar to quickly locate a specific hotlist or applying filters based on parameters such as Created by , Created on , and Updated on . Conclusion: Using hotlists in Recruit CRM allows you to group similar records, perform powerful bulk actions, and collaborate efficiently with your team. t: How does syncing your Calendar to Recruit CRM work?
s: This article will help you understand how syncing your calendar to Recruit CRM works, and how it affects your tasks and meetings.
h: Meetings:
Tasks:
Troubleshooting
Problem: A meeting created in Recruit CRM is not showing in Google or Outlook.
FAQs
1. Does Recruit CRM sync both meetings and tasks with my calendar?
Conclusion:
b: Calendar sync in Recruit CRM lets you have all your meetings synced with your Google or Outlook calendar in just three clicks. Click here to learn about integrating your Google/Outlook Calendar Meetings: When you sync your calendar to Recruit CRM, your meetings will be automatically synced in both Recruit CRM and your calendar. Meetings can be created from three different places within the Recruit CRM app. Click here to learn more about Scheduling Meetings Meetings created in Recruit CRM are automatically added to your connected Google or Microsoft Outlook calendar and vice versa. Any updates made to meetings sync both ways between Recruit CRM and your calendar. ​ When you are viewing a candidate or contact details page, Recruit CRM automatically checks for new or updated meetings from your connected calendar. The sync runs every 15 minutes , and once completed, the latest meeting details are updated on the candidate/contact profile as well as the Meetings list page . ​ Deleting a meeting does not sync across platforms. If you delete a meeting in Recruit CRM, it will remain in your calendar, and if you delete it from your calendar, it will remain in Recruit CRM. Please note that deleting a recurring meeting from your calendar will not remove it from Recruit CRM. You will need to delete it manually in Recruit CRM. Tasks: Tasks do not sync between Recruit CRM and your calendar. Any task created in either platform will remain available only in the platform where it was created. Click here to learn about Tasks and Meetings Troubleshooting Problem: A meeting created in Recruit CRM is not showing in Google or Outlook. Likely cause: Calendar sync is not properly connected. What to check: Confirm your Google or Outlook calendar is connected in Recruit CRM and that sync is active. Resolution path: Reconnect your calendar, then create a new test meeting in Recruit CRM to verify it reflects in your calendar. FAQs 1. Does Recruit CRM sync both meetings and tasks with my calendar? No. Only meetings sync. Tasks created on your calendar won't be synced to Recruit CRM, and tasks created on Recruit CRM won't be synced to your calendar. Conclusion: Calendar sync in Recruit CRM helps you keep meetings aligned between Recruit CRM and your Google or Outlook calendar. By understanding how meetings, recurring events, and tasks behave with sync, you can manage your schedule across both systems. t: How does the AI Resume Parser work?
s: A quick explanation on how the resume parser works in Recruit CRM.
h: What This Feature Does and When to Use It?
Step-by-Step Instructions
How to Parse a Resume in Recruit CRM:
FAQs
Will parsing a resume create a new candidate every time?
Conclusion
b: What This Feature Does and When to Use It? The AI Resume Parser in Recruit CRM extracts candidate information from resumes and creates candidate profiles instantly. The parser will capture details such as the Candidate’s Name, Phone Number, Email, City, Full Address, Specialization, Work Experience Year, Work Experience Month, Current Organization, Title, Skills, Language Skills, Summary, Educational Qualification, Work and Education History and social medial URLs like Facebook URL, Twitter URL, LinkedIn URL, GitHub URL, Xing URL (if any). It will also extract the candidate’s work and education history from their resume. Additionally, the parser works with the resumes received from: Job Application Forms Talent Pool Forms As well as when candidates update their profile using the Profile Update Request Form. This feature is especially useful for: Reducing manual data entry during recruitment. Quickly processing and parsing candidate resumes. Note: Updating Existing Candidate Profiles while parsing CV When you parse a resume, Recruit CRM will first check if a candidate with the same Email ID, LinkedIn URL, or Contact Number already exists in your database. If a match is found, the parser will update the existing profile. Any empty fields in the profile will be filled with new information from the resume. Existing data will not be overwritten by default. The "Override Data" toggle, which allows new data to replace existing information, is *not* available when parsing individual resumes. This toggle is exclusively used during the bulk import process. Click here to learn about how to bulk Import Step-by-Step Instructions How to Parse a Resume in Recruit CRM: Click the Import Candidate dropdown and choose Resume Parser to open the resume parsing option. Upload the candidate resumes or simply drag and drop them into the parser window. Recruit CRM will automatically extract and populate candidate details from the resume. Once completed, a new candidate profile will be created, or the existing profile will be updated if a matching candidate is found. Click here to learn more about 'How to Parse a Resume'. You can use our Boolean Search feature to search all the information in a candidate’s resume/CV. FAQs Will parsing a resume create a new candidate every time? No. Recruit CRM first checks for existing candidates using the email address, LinkedIn URL, or contact number. If a match is found, the existing profile is updated instead of creating a duplicate candidate. Conclusion The AI Resume Parser in Recruit CRM helps recruiters save time and improve efficiency by automatically extracting and organizing candidate information from resumes. By reducing manual data entry and creating structured candidate profiles instantly, the feature helps streamline and simplify the recruitment process. t: How Email Open Tracking Works in Recruit CRM?
s: This article explains how email open tracking works in Recruit CRM, how to enable the tracking pixel, and how to see which emails have been opened.
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
Before you begin:
How does email open tracking work in Recruit CRM?
How to track opened emails in Recruit CRM?
Troubleshooting
FAQs
Does the recipient see the tracking pixel?
Conclusion:
b: What this feature does and when to use it? This feature lets you monitor which emails have been opened so you can prioritize follow-ups and understand engagement. You can use this feature when: You want to see when candidates or contacts open your emails. You want real-time notifications when emails are opened. Important Note: Email tracking in Recruit CRM shows how many times an email was opened, but the email tracking pixel does not identify whether the email was opened by the sender or the receiver. The tracking pixel gets triggered when the email is clicked/opened. Before you begin: The tracking pixel will be added for emails when the Track Sent Emails toggle is enabled in your profile settings. Here is how to add the email tracking pixel: 1. Navigate to the top left corner of the screen and click on your profile avatar. 2. Ensure that the " Track Sent Emails " toggle is set to 'ON'. Enabling this toggle will automatically insert a pixel (an invisible image) into every email sent from Recruit CRM, allowing you to monitor when recipients open the email. How does email open tracking work in Recruit CRM? When you send an email from Recruit CRM, a small "invisible" image of 1 Px is attached to your email. The person receiving your email never sees the image. For email open tracking to work, your recipient's email service provider should allow images to be displayed. For some email clients, it is on by default but for some email clients like Zoho, you might get options like the one in the image below: Once your recipient clicks on 'Display now', that particular email will be tracked and you will get a notification about your email being opened on Recruit CRM. If your recipient doesn't click on the display image, your email won't be tracked & you will not receive any notification on Recruit CRM. How to track opened emails in Recruit CRM? 1. Open your mailbox in Recruit CRM and locate the Opened section. This section tracks and displays emails that have been opened. Use the notification panel in Recruit CRM to see real-time notifications for the most recent emails that have been opened. Troubleshooting Problem: You are not receiving any email open notifications in Recruit CRM. Likely cause : The tracking pixel is not enabled, or the recipient’s email client is blocking images. What to check: Confirm that the Track Sent Emails toggle in your profile settings is set to On . Check whether the recipient’s email client requires them to click “Display now” or a similar option to load images. Resolution path: Enable the tracking toggle in your profile, then resend the email. 🤔FAQs Does the recipient see the tracking pixel? No. The person receiving your email never sees the image. It is a small, invisible 1-pixel image added only for tracking purposes. Conclusion: By enabling the tracking toggle, understanding how image display affects tracking, and using the Mailbox and notification panel, you can monitor engagement and follow up at the right time. If you need more help, you can contact our support team.
