b: This article explains how to use the Recruit Craft Website Builder to create, customize, and publish a branded website directly from Recruit Craft. ✨ What this feature does and when to use it The Recruit Craft Website Builder is a drag-and-drop website builder that allows you to create and manage branded websites directly inside Recruit Craft. With the Website Builder, you can create: • A Full Website with multiple pages, such as Home, About Us, FAQs, Testimonials, and custom pages •Career pages for publishing jobs and job application/candidate portal in a unified website experience. The builder includes a visual editor with drag-and-drop sections and elements, responsive previews, SEO settings, and publishing tools. This feature is especially useful when you: • Want to create a fully branded recruitment website without coding • Want your Jobs page and Candidate Portal under one website experience • Need drag-and-drop editing for website pages • Want to manage pages, layouts, and branding from one place • Need responsive previews before publishing • Want to customize SEO settings for website pages 📂 Access the Projects Dashboard The Projects Dashboard is the first page you land on after logging in to Recruit Craft. From here, you can view and manage all your Recruit Craft projects, including both live published websites and unpublished projects currently being worked on. From the dashboard, you can: • View projects • Create projects • Edit projects • Preview projects • Rename projects • Publish projects • Delete projects • Open live projects ​ Projects are marked as: • Published • Unpublished ​ ➕ Create a New Project Follow these steps to create a new project in Recruit Craft: Open the Projects Dashboard . Click + Create Project at the top-right corner of the dashboard. Choose one of the following project types based on the kind of website experience you want to create: 📄 Build only Career Page Site Use this option if you only want to create a dedicated jobs page experience for candidates. The Career Page builder includes the refreshed Career Page design while continuing to support the existing functionality and settings already available in Recruit Craft. This option is best suited for teams that primarily want to: • Publish open jobs • Share a branded jobs page • Allow candidates to browse and apply for roles 🌐 Build Full Website The Full Website builder allows you to create a fully branded recruitment website experience that goes beyond just jobs and candidate applications. You can build informational and branding-focused pages to showcase your company, services, culture, testimonials, FAQs, and more, while also allowing visitors to browse jobs, apply for roles, and access the Candidate Portal from one centralized platform. A Full Website can include multiple pages such as: • Home page • Jobs page • Job Application page • Candidate Portal • About Us page • Testimonials page • FAQ page • Custom pages ​ 🎨 Choose a Template After selecting the project type, the next step is to choose the template that will act as the starting point for your website or career page. Recruit Craft provides ready-made templates to help you quickly build and customize your project without starting completely from scratch. 1. For Full Website Projects If you selected Build Full Website , you can: • Choose from the available website templates, or • Start with a completely blank project Website templates come with prebuilt layouts and sections that can help speed up the website creation process. These templates can then be fully customized using the drag-and-drop Website Builder editor. Starting with a blank project allows you to build the website structure and design entirely from scratch. 2. For Career Page Projects If you selected Build Career Page , you can choose from the available Career Page templates. These templates are specifically designed for job listing and candidate application experiences while continuing to support the existing Career Page functionality and settings. ​ Once you select a template, the project will automatically open in the Website Builder editor, where you can begin customizing pages, sections, elements, layouts, branding, and content. 🖥️ Understand the Website Builder Editor The Website Builder includes a visual editing interface with 4 main areas. Left Sidebar The left sidebar is used to add new content to your website, such as elements, sections, and pages. Simply drag and drop the required items from the sidebar onto the canvas to start building your website. ​ Central Canvas The central canvas is the main workspace where you can view, build, and edit your website. Any elements, sections, or pages added from the left sidebar can be placed and arranged here. ​ Right Sidebar The right sidebar provides customization and editing options for the item currently selected on the canvas. From here, you can modify design settings, content, styling, spacing, and other properties related to the selected element or section. ​ Top Toolbar The top toolbar contains controls that help you manage and navigate your website design. From here, you can switch between pages, adjust the zoom level of the canvas, and access other page-level controls while editing. The top toolbar includes: • Page selector • Zoom controls • Desktop, Tablet, and Mobile preview controls • Preview • Save • Publish 📑 Add and Manage Pages The Pages section allows you to manage all the pages within your website project. From here, you can: Add a New Page To create a new page: Open the Pages section from the left sidebar. Click the Add New Page button. Enter the Page Name when prompted. Click Add . The new page will automatically be created and added to the pages list, where you can begin customizing it using sections and elements. Switch Between Pages You can switch between website pages at any time while editing. There are two ways to switch pages: • Click on any page directly from the list inside the Pages section • Use the Page Selector from the top toolbar to quickly navigate between pages The selected page will automatically open in the Website Builder editor. Access and customize the Jobs Page From the Pages section, you can also access the Jobs List Page, Job Description, and Job Application Form . The Jobs-related pages are managed slightly differently from standard website pages. ​ 📌 Please note: The Jobs List Page , Job Description Page , and Job Application Form continue to use the dedicated Career Page editor experience. You can customize and manage these pages using the available Career Page settings, while the rest of your website pages can be built and customized using the drag-and-drop Website Builder. Enable the Candidate Portal The Candidate Portal can also be enabled directly from the Pages section. Once enabled, candidates will be able to access the Candidate Portal experience from your website. 🧩 Add and Customize Elements Available elements include: Text Buttons Lines Images Socials Videos Each element can be customized using the settings available in the right sidebar, including layout, styling, spacing, sizing, and other element-specific options. ​ 🧱 Add and Customize Sections The Sections panel includes predefined website sections. These sections can be dragged directly into the page. ​ Available sections include: • Flexbox • Grid • Space • Header • Footer • Hero • Testimonials • FAQs • About Us • Banner • Block quote • Form • Custom HTML ​ 🛠️ Create and customize your website Follow these steps to build and customize your website using Recruit Craft: Step 1: Choose what you want to work on Start by deciding whether you want to add new content to your website or edit existing content. To add new content, use the left sidebar and select the type of item you want to add: • Section – Add a new website section, such as a hero banner, testimonials section, or contact form. • Element – Add individual components such as text, buttons, images, social icons, lines, forms, videos, and more. • Page – Create additional pages for your website. Step 2: Add content to the canvas Once you have selected the section or element you want to use, drag and drop it from the left sidebar onto the central canvas. Place the item in the desired location on your website layout. The canvas provides a real-time view of your website, allowing you to see exactly where the content will appear. ​ Step 3: Edit existing content If you do not want to add new content, you can simply select an existing section or element directly from the canvas. Clicking on an existing item will automatically make it active for editing and display the available customization options in the right sidebar. ​ Step 4: Customize your content After selecting or adding an item, use the right sidebar to customize its settings. The available options will vary depending on the item selected but may include: • Content editing • Design and styling options • Layout and spacing controls • Colors and typograph

t: Recruit Craft: No-Code Career Page & Candidate Portal Builder
s: This article provides a deeper look into Recruit Craft and the features it offers.
h: Features of Recruit Craft
1. Customizable Templates
3. One-Click Candidate Portal
4. Automatic Resume Parsing
5. Custom Domain Integration
8. Google for Jobs Support
b: Recruit Craft is a simple yet powerful no-code tool built to create professional, branded career pages and seamless candidate portals without relying on developers. It is an add-on subscription which integrates directly with Recruit CRM , allowing you to publish jobs, collect applications, and deliver smooth candidate experiences, all in just a few clicks. 🎯Features of Recruit Craft 1. Customizable Templates Recruit Craft offers ready-to-use templates , designed to look professional and polished. You can easily tailor them to match your brand by adjusting colors, fonts, logos, and layout without any coding. 2. Real-Time Editing Make changes to your page instantly. Whether you're updating content, tweaking design, or adjusting job listings, everything reflects live with zero downtime . You can display the Job ID on job description pages by enabling the Show Job ID toggle in the Job Description page settings. Once enabled, the Job ID appears automatically on the page. 3. One-Click Candidate Portal Candidates can: Apply quickly without filling in the same information again Reuse previously submitted details Check their application status anytime This creates a smooth, efficient experience for candidates. More about Candidate Portal 4. Automatic Resume Parsing Recruit Craft includes built-in resume parsing to help candidates complete applications faster and reduce manual data entry. When a candidate uploads a resume through: • A Job Application Form • The Candidate Portal • The Create Profile flow within the Candidate Portal Recruit Craft automatically extracts relevant information from the resume and populates the corresponding profile fields. This follows the same resume parsing functionality used in Recruit CRM, and the fields parsed in Recruit Craft match the fields currently supported by the Recruit CRM resume parser. By automatically populating candidate information, you receive more complete candidate profiles while candidates spend less time manually entering their details. ​ ​ More about the Resume Parser 5. Custom Domain Integration Host your career page on your own domain or subdomain, making it look and feel like a natural extension of your website. 6. Seamless Integration with Recruit CRM Jobs and applications flow automatically between your career page and Recruit CRM , saving time and reducing manual work. 7. SEO-Optimized Job Pages Each job listing is built with SEO best practices in mind, helping your openings show up higher in search engine results and rank better. This makes your jobs more visible to potential candidates and helps attract more qualified applicants—without needing to spend on ads. 8. Google for Jobs Support All listings are structured to meet the Google for Jobs schema , which means they get automatically indexed by Google which boosts visibility and brings in more organic applicants. Hope this helps! s: This article will guide you to set up the Recruit CRM MCP server to connect your account to AI assistants like Claude and Codex.
h: Recruit CRM MCP Server

b: Recruit CRM MCP Server Connect your Recruit CRM account to AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, or Perplexity and interact with your recruitment data using natural language. 🔑 [IMPORTANT] Previously connected using an API key? Recruit CRM MCP previously authenticated with a single account-wide API key — one key per account, giving full access to your entire database regardless of user role. This has been replaced by OAuth-based authentication, scoped to each individual user's role and permissions. If you were connected using the old API key method, that connection no longer works. To reconnect: Delete the existing Recruit CRM connection in Claude, ChatGPT, or whichever app you used it with — the old API key–based connection won't upgrade itself and needs to be removed first. Confirm MCP Access is enabled for your role: Go to Admin Settings → User → Roles & Permissions and enable MCP Access for the user role. Please contact your admin if you don't have access to the Roles & Permissions settings. ​ The old API key had full access by default; the new OAuth connection only works if your role is explicitly granted MCP Access. ​ Reconnect using the OAuth steps below for your AI app. ⚠️ If the old API key is no longer used anywhere else, rotate or revoke it — it still grants full account access to anyone holding it. Who Is This For? This is intended for Recruit CRM Users who want to connect their Recruit CRM data to an AI assistant like Claude or ChatGPT via MCP (Model Context Protocol). Prerequisite The Recruit CRM MCP feature is available only on the Business and Enterprise plans. MCP Access needs to be enabled for the User's Role: Go to Admin Settings → User → Roles & Permissions and enable MCP Access for the user role. Note: By Default, Account Owner and Admins have MCP access. Claude Setup For the Claude Team plan, the Admin needs to add the connector for the team. Click here to view a quick help guide on it. For Pro and Max plans (individual users): Method 1: You can click on this link: https://claude.ai/directory/recruit-crm and click on the 'Connect to Claude' button. On the authentication page that opens, click on ' Authorize' to connect. Method 2: Go to Customize → Connectors Click "+" , then "Add custom connector" Enter the MCP server URL: https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp and click "Add" Click "Connect" on the Recruit CRM connector that appears On the authentication page that opens, click on ' Authorize' to connect. Enabling connectors after configuration You can enable connectors for individual conversations via the “+” button on the lower left of your chat interface, then "Connectors." You'll see your configured connectors with toggles allowing you to enable/disable them per conversation. Reference For more details, see Claude’s guide on custom connectors using remote MCP: https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp ChatGPT Setup Remote MCP connectors require Developer Mode on ChatGPT Open ChatGPT Settings, navigate to Security and login, then scroll down to enable Developer mode. ​ Open ChatGPT and go to Plugins ​ Click on the "Plus" icon Enter name: Recruit CRM and paste the MCP server URL: https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp Upload Logo (optional) Select Authentication: OAuth (if not selected by default) Check: I understand and want to continue Click the ‘Create’ button Follow the on-screen instructions to connect Reference For more details, see ChatGPT’s guide on MCP and Developer Mode: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/12584461-developer-mode-and-mcp-apps-in-chatgpt Perplexity Setup Navigate to the correct settings page: For your account: Account settings → Connectors For the organization (admins only): Enterprise settings → Permissions → Connectors permissions Click + Custom connector in the top-right corner. In the modal pop-up, select Remote . Fill in the required fields: Name : Recruit CRM MCP Server URL : https://agent.recruitcrm.io/mcp Optionally, fill in these additional fields: Description : A short explanation of what the connector does. Authentication : OAuth Transport : Streamable HTTP Check the acknowledgment box to confirm you understand the risks of custom connectors. Click Add . The connector will appear in the Connectors screen in your Account settings . Click the connector card to start the authentication flow and enable it. To modify or remove the connector later, click the ellipsis (⋮) and choose the appropriate option. Reference For more details, see Perplexity’s guide on adding custom connectors: https://www.perplexity.ai/help-center/en/articles/13915507-adding-custom-remote-connectors Gemini Gemini does not currently support custom remote MCP connectors in the standard consumer Gemini web app (gemini.google.com) or Gemini mobile apps. Custom MCP servers are only available in Gemini Enterprise (Google Cloud), which is a separate enterprise product. If your organization uses Gemini Enterprise, your administrator can add custom MCP data stores — contact your Google Cloud admin for setup. What Can It Do? Once connected, you can ask your AI assistant questions like: "Show me open jobs for Acme Corp" "What tasks are due this week?" "Pull up recent notes on John Smith" "Show call logs from last month" "Show me Frank's progression across all jobs" "How many candidates are in interview hiring stage for Sales Consultant?" "Which candidates on the Senior Engineer role have been idle for more than 7 days?" "Review candidates added today and create notes on what to discuss during the initial phone call based on their profiles." "Give me a bottleneck report for this job and suggest what to do next" "For the 'Director of Product Management' (Job ID-842), review all candidates in the Shortlist stage and prepare a professional, modern-themed executive search report, including an executive summary and other notable details." Currently supported: Entities & Activities Supported Actions Candidates Find candidates, review profiles and job history, create or update records, assign them to jobs, move them through hiring stages, and manage off-limit status. Jobs Find roles by title, company, owner, or status; review assigned candidates by stage; create or update jobs; and diagnose pipeline bottlenecks. Companies Find companies, review account details, create or update company records, and manage off-limit status. Contacts Find contacts, review relationship history, create or update records, pitch candidates, track pitch progress, and manage off-limit status. Tasks Find upcoming or overdue work, review related context, create tasks, and update existing tasks. Meetings Find scheduled meetings, review attendees and related records, create meetings, and update meeting details. Notes Search notes across candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, and deals; create notes; and update existing notes. Call Logs Review call activity, log new calls, and update existing call records. Hotlists Find hotlists, create new lists, and add records to existing lists. Custom Fields Custom fields are supported for searching, creating, and updating records, including parent-child dependencies. Client Briefs Prepare account briefs with open jobs, contacts, candidate pipeline status, recent activity, risks, and recommended follow-ups. Pipeline Analysis Diagnose a job's hiring pipeline. Returns stage distribution, days-in-current-stage per candidate, idle candidate detection, bottleneck verdict, recent activity (notes, meetings, tasks), etc. Search experience All entity search tools now work like search inside the Recruit CRM app. Boolean search support for more precise candidate and entity discovery Advanced Filter search support for narrowing results using structured criteria App-like search behavior across entities for a more familiar and more powerful MCP experience. This version does not support delete actions in Recruit CRM. Write operations are supported and occur only when explicitly requested. If your use case isn't supported yet, let us know through Recruit CRM Support - we'd love to hear what you need. ⚠️ Data Privacy - Please Read Carefully When you use this MCP server, your Recruit CRM data is sent to the AI assistant you're using (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT). This means: Candidate profiles , names, email, phone, job history, hiring stage, etc. will be exposed to the AI provider so that it can assist with the data. Company and contact data , job details, notes, and call logs may also be exposed depending on what you ask. The AI provider processes this data on their servers according to their own privacy and data retention policies. What you should check before using: Most AI providers (including Claude) have a data retention period - typically around 30 days for conversation data, though this varies by plan and provider. t: Recruit CRM API Documentation
s: API docs, Webhooks
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
API Access: Account Owner vs. Admin Roles
How to Access Your API Token?
Creating a candidate using the API endpoint
Retrieve Call Transcripts via API
Parsing a resume using the API endpoint
Duplicate Handling
Overriding existing data
b: Important Note: The Open API is only available to users on the "Business" plan or higher. Alternatively, organizations with formal partnerships with Recruit CRM may also qualify to access the API. Additionally, only the Account Owner can manage API keys for added security. What this feature does and when to use it? The Recruit CRM API allows external systems and applications to securely interact with Recruit CRM data using standard HTTP methods such as GET, POST, and DELETE. Using an API token for authentication, you can connect Recruit CRM with third-party tools and custom applications. You can use this feature when: • You want to connect Recruit CRM with external tools, custom applications, or reporting dashboards • You are a developer implementing secure API authentication and integration workflows • You require API access to automate candidate creation, resume parsing, timesheet retrieval, or data synchronization • You want to build custom workflows and integrations using Recruit CRM data Our API Documentation is available live at https://docs.recruitcrm.io Important note for the developer While asking our API to GET/POST/DELETE the required data, one must not directly query the endpoint on the front end/webpage, as it exposes the API token. You would need to hide the Recruit CRM API token/Bearer token. This can be done by introducing a server in between or by making the API token abstract. Basically, the webpage on the front end would query a private server in between which would then query the Recruit CRM API. This is the safest way of doing this, as it would then prevent exposing the Recruit CRM API token/key publicly. Also, if you encounter an error while using the API key, please ensure that you are not on a Free Trial account and generating a new API key on your end, as this may otherwise result in a 401 Authorization error ( INSUFFICIENT_ACCESS - Please Upgrade Your Plan to “Business” or “Enterprise” to gain access to the Open API). While API tokens are available across all plans for integration with Workflow Automation (accessible to all plans), access to our public API requires a Business plan or higher. These restrictions are specifically designed to ensure that sensitive organizational data remains protected and API tokens are managed by trusted individuals. Recruit CRM prioritizes security by limiting API access to Account Owners, thereby maintaining data integrity. API Access: Account Owner vs. Admin Roles Even if you have an Admin role within Recruit CRM, you cannot generate or retrieve the API key unless you are also the Account Owner. This measure ensures enhanced security by limiting access to the most trusted individual in the organization. If you are an Admin user and need API access, you may: Request that the Account Owner retrieve the API key on your behalf, or Ask the Account Owner to create a custom role for you with the necessary permissions to access the API token. How to Access Your API Token? Here are the step-by-step instructions to enable and copy your API token as the Account Owner. Navigate to Admin Settings . ​ Scroll down and click on API to open the API section. Note: Only the Account Owner can access and manage this section to ensure compliance with security measures. Turn the toggle to the ON position to enable the API token. ​ Copy the displayed API token. Store it securely in your integration tool, backend server configuration, or secret manager. Avoid saving it in plain text files or sharing it over unsecured channels. Creating a candidate using the API endpoint You can use the 'Creates a new candidate' endpoint to create a new candidate: Retrieve Call Transcripts via API You can also retrieve generated call transcripts via the API. In the Find Call Log via API endpoint, you can use the boolean query parameter: transcript_required . When transcript_required is set to true , you can retrieve: The full call transcript text. Transcript segments with corresponding timestamps. Parsing a resume using the API endpoint You can use the 'Resume Parser' API to upload a resume and automatically create or update a candidate in Recruit CRM. From the API Endpoints Documentation , select the Resume Parser endpoint, and upload the resume file in a supported format like PDF, DOC, DOCX, or RTF. Once you send the request, the system will read the resume and extract basic details such as Candidate’s Name, Phone Number, Email, City, Full Address, Specialization, Work Experience Year, Work Experience Month, Current Organization, Title, Skills, Language Skills, Summary, Educational Qualification, Work and Education History and social medial URLs like Facebook URL, Twitter URL, LinkedIn URL, GitHub URL, Xing URL (if any). Duplicate Handling Duplicate handling is based on the “Allow Duplicate Candidates” setting in Admin Settings → Account Management . If this setting is on, a new candidate is always created. If this setting is off, the system checks for an existing candidate and updates the record based on the parsed resume data. Overriding existing data You can control how existing candidate data is updated using the override_data parameter. If it is set to no , only empty or missing fields are filled, and existing data remains unchanged. If it is set to yes , the existing candidate details are updated with the newly parsed information. If duplicate candidates are allowed, this setting is ignored and a new candidate is created instead. Note Parsing custom fields is not supported. Bulk parsing or parsing multiple resumes in a single call is not supported. Retrieving all timesheets using the API endpoint You can retrieve a list of all timesheets from Recruit CRM using the 'Get All Timesheets' endpoint. This allows you to access the timesheet data, making it easier to integrate with external systems such as payroll or reporting tools. Fetching timesheet details using the API endpoint You can fetch detailed information for a specific timesheet using the 'Get Timesheet by ID' endpoint. This enables you to access complete timesheet records, including detailed timelogs. Additionally, two response parameters, is_contractor and contractor_status, are available across the following six existing candidate endpoints: Search for Candidates, Edit Candidate, Find Candidate by Slug, Get List of candidates which are marked as off limit, Show All Candidates, and Un-assign Candidate. Troubleshooting Problem: You cannot see the API section or API token in Admin Settings. Likely cause : You are not logged in as the account owner. ​ ​ What to check : Confirm your role (account owner vs admin vs other). ​ ​ Resolution: Log in as the account owner, or ask the account owner to either retrieve the token for you or create a custom role that grants API token access. FAQs Who can manage and view the Recruit CRM API token? Only the account owner can manage and retrieve the API token by default. Admin users cannot access the token unless the account owner grants a custom role with explicit permission to access the API token. Is the API available on all Recruit CRM plans? No. The API is only available to users on the Business plan or higher. Organizations with a formal partnership with Recruit CRM may also qualify for API access. Can I call the Recruit CRM API directly from my website or client-side application? No. You must not directly query the API endpoint from a front-end webpage or client-side application using the API token, because this exposes the token and can compromise your data security. Always use the API token on the server side. Where can I find the official Recruit CRM API documentation? The API documentation is available online at the Recruit CRM API documentation link: https://docs.recruitcrm.io Conclusion: Using the Recruit CRM API securely starts with ensuring only authorized users manage the API token and that it is never exposed in front-end environments. By following the role requirements, plan prerequisites, and security guidelines in this article, you can confidently enable integrations. For the full list of available endpoints, request parameters, and response formats, visit the official API documentation at docs.recruitcrm.io . If you need further help, use the chat icon at the bottom right of the screen to reach the support team. b: What this feature does and when to use it? The Recruit CRM Chrome Extension is a plugin for Chromium-based browsers that lets you source candidates, contacts, and companies directly from supported platforms into Recruit CRM with just one click! Before you begin: Please note: The Chrome Extension works only on Chromium-based browsers, including Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave browser, etc. The feature is available on all plans (free/pro/business/enterprise). The compatible platforms for the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension are LinkedIn, LinkedIn Recruiter, Recruiter Lite, Sales Navigator, Outlook, ZoomInfo, Xing, Xing Talent Manager, Indeed, Naukri Recruitment Management System, Naukri Resdex, Seek, and HH.RU (HeadHunter Russia). Our extension is designed to enhance productivity and save you valuable time. Chrome Extension on Seek: The Chrome Extension is also compatible with Seek. However, please ensure that the extension is updated to the latest version (v3.2.8 or later) and it will only function on the following page: talent.seek.com.au/candidates When adding candidates, the work and education history will be parsed from the resume if one is attached to the candidate’s profile using the resume parser. If no resume is attached, the system will instead parse this information from the details available on the candidate’s profile.The extension currently works only with specific filters available on the page-​ Chrome Extension on Xing: The extension fetches both work and education history when sourcing profiles from Xing to capture more detailed candidate information. 🌐 How to set up the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension? 1. The first step is to download the Recruit CRM Chrome extension from the Google Webstore. Click here to download the Chrome Extension 2. Next, you'll need to pin the extension to your browser for easy access. Click here to learn how to pin Chrome extension To ensure the Chrome extension works properly, it's important to have third-party cookies enabled. Please check out this article for guidance on enabling them to ensure the extension functions as intended: Third-Party cookies for Chrome Extension ®️ How to use the Recruit CRM Chrome extension? 1. Once the extension is pinned, you can start sourcing candidates/contacts/companies by clicking the R button when you're on any profile page. 2. The extension will parse the information and you can add/edit details, and perform follow-up actions on the records such as adding notes, tasks, and meetings, assigning them to jobs, or adding them to hotlists. Click here to know how to add more fields on the Chrome Extension Note: The Work and Education history will not be displayed on the extension upfront, but once the candidate is saved, the data will be shown inside Recruit CRM under the Work and Education History section. Also, Work & Education History and Skills of the candidate will be parsed/added only if " Save LinkedIn Resume " is checked. 3. Once you click "Save", the record will be added to your Recruit CRM database. Note: After you save a candidate/contact/company using the Chrome extension, our Resume Parser runs in the background and updates the details within 1-3 minutes after the profile is saved . When the Chrome Extension detects that a candidate, company, or contact already exists in your Recruit CRM database, a pop-up notification will appear at the top of the extension indicating that the record already exists . The notification will also show the record owner and provide an option to view the existing record in Recruit CRM. For example: Company Recruit CRM Already Exists In Your Database (Owner: John Doe). View In Recruit CRM. ​ ​ If the record already exists in your Recruit CRM database, we just update empty fields on Recruit CRM with the new information captured by the extension. ​ However, if the " Override Data " toggle is enabled in the Chrome Extension settings, then all the existing information in Recruit CRM will be overridden by the new information captured by the extension. To access the Chrome Extension settings and find the 'Override Data' toggle, click on the Chrome Extension icon in your browser toolbar, then click on the gear/settings icon within the extension's pop-up window. Note: A candidate’s current organization will always be updated with the latest data when sourcing via the Chrome Extension, even if the Override Data toggle is turned off. This ensures users never miss the most up-to-date employer information. 🎥 Here's a tutorial on how to use the Chrome Extension on LinkedIn! Automatic company linking for Candidates and Contacts You can enable the Save Candidate as Contact option while saving a LinkedIn profile using the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension. When this option is selected, both a Candidate record and a Contact record are created for the same LinkedIn profile, and the system automatically links both records to the same associated Company during creation. This works for: Existing Companies already available in Recruit CRM Companies that are automatically created when the Auto-create Company setting is enabled in Admin Settings Please note: On the Chrome extension, the "Current Organization" field for candidates and contacts is a searchable field instead of plain text. ​ As you type, it will show matching existing companies to select from, so the candidate/contact gets linked to the right company automatically. In case of candidates, if no match is found, your typed text is used to create a new company on save (based on your account's "Auto-create Company for Candidate's Current Organization from Extension" setting under Account Settings ). 🎯 How to Use the Click To Parse Feature on the Chrome Extension The Click to Parse feature allows you to quickly capture and parse profile details without opening the candidate/contact/company profile! When enabled, you will see a small “R” button on the profile picture. This button lets you instantly extract information and add it to Recruit CRM without manual entry or clicking on the profile. To use this feature, simply click on the small "R" button visible near their profile picture , and the system will extract details like name, email, phone number, and other available information in the same manner the extension usually does on individual profiles. It will create or update the information in your database accordingly. You can turn this feature on or off from the Recruit CRM Chrome Extension settings . If you do not see the option on a profile, make sure the "Click To Parse" toggle is enabled in your extension settings. 📱Download the Chrome extension on your Android mobile phone! 👈 Here are the simple steps! Follow the steps listed below to download the Chrome Extension on your Android mobile phone: 1. Download the Kiwi Browser from the Play Store. 2. Now open the browser, install the Recruit CRM sourcing extension , and pin it to Chrome. 3. Open the browser and log in to Recruit CRM and LinkedIn : and you are all set to source Candidates/Contacts/Companies from LinkedIn to Recruit CRM. Here's a video on this: https://www.loom.com/share/cf17fd77e1c74869bff93f89c3a7e068 📞 Book a Demo! Want to see how Recruit CRM can work for you? Book a demo today and let us show you the possibilities! Click here to book a demo Troubleshooting Problem: Click to Parse Add button is not visible on profile pictures Likely cause : The Click to Parse feature is disabled or the current view is not supported. What to check : In the extension settings, confirm that the Click to Parse toggle is turned on. Verify that you are on a supported platform and results/listing view . Resolution : Enable Click to Parse in settings. Refresh the page after enabling. If still not visible, try another supported platform or view known to work with Click to Parse. Problem: The extension is not working properly on SEEK Likely cause : Outdated extension version or unsupported SEEK page. What to check : Confirm that your extension version is 3.2.8 or later . Confirm that you are on the supported SEEK page where the extension is designed to function. Resolution : Update the extension to the latest version from the Chrome Web Store. Navigate to the correct SEEK page as specified in your internal documentation or support article. 🤔FAQs Does LinkedIn have a limit for profiles that we can source? No, LinkedIn doesn't have a limit for profiles, however, it does have a limit for the PDFs that you can choose to also download together with the sourcing of candidates. Currently, you can only do 100 PDFs per month. t: Recruit CRM Enterprise Plan Features
s: This article explains the key Recruit CRM Enterprise Plan features that help streamline recruiting, improve data quality, and centralize communication.
h: 1. Workflow automation
2. Advanced analytics
3. Data enrichment
4. Job multiposting

b: Recruit CRM comes packed with powerful features in every subscription plan. The following are the Enterprise plan features which can also be added at an additional cost to the Pro or the Business plan subscriptions. 1. Workflow automation Automate repetitive recruiting tasks and connect Recruit CRM with your favorite apps. This helps you save hours of manual work and ensures your team stays efficient. ​ Click here to learn more about Workflow Automation 2. Advanced analytics Get deeper insights into your business with advanced dashboards and custom reports. Perfect for data-driven teams who want to track performance beyond standard reports. ​ Click here to learn more about Advanced Analytics 3. Data enrichment Find missing contact details like emails and phone numbers for candidates and clients/contacts with just one click. This makes sourcing and outreach faster and more reliable. ​ Click here to learn more about Data Enrichment 4. Job multiposting Post jobs to multiple job boards directly from Recruit CRM in one go. This saves time and increases visibility for your job postings. ​ Click here to learn more about Job Multiposting 5. LinkedIn messaging integration Bring your LinkedIn conversations into Recruit CRM so you can manage all candidate communication in one place. This ensures nothing slips through the cracks. ​ Click here to learn more about LinkedIn Messaging Integration 6. AI sourcing AI Sourcing lets you find high-quality candidate profiles from across the internet - without ever leaving Recruit CRM. You can use filters (like job titles or locations) or just type in what you're looking for. Our system will then search online and show you the most relevant profiles, which you can review and import directly into the system. ​ Click here to learn more about AI Sourcing ​ 7. Calling Recruit CRM offers a built-in calling feature that enables users to make calls directly from the platform. This feature is available through a credit-based system. To initiate calls, users need to purchase calling credits. These credits are consumed based on the duration of the call. Once the credits are depleted, users must purchase additional credits to continue making calls. Click here to learn more about Setting Up Calling in Recruit CRM ​ 8. Texting Recruit CRM enables users to send SMS messages to candidates and contacts directly from the platform, powered by Twilio . To utilize the texting feature, users must purchase credits. These credits are used for both sending and receiving messages. The cost is determined by factors such as message segments and carrier charges. Additionally, a token fee may apply for obtaining a texting number, varying by country. Click here to learn more about Texting Candidates/Contacts in RecruitCRM 9. RecruitCraft Recruit Craft is a no-code tool that helps you create professional, branded career pages and candidate portals without needing a developer. It works in tandem with Recruit CRM, so your jobs and applications sync automatically. You can use customizable templates, edit your careers site in real time, set up a one-click candidate portal, use your own domain, and get SEO-optimized, Google for Jobs–ready job pages. RecruitCraft is included in the Enterprise plan at no extra cost. Click here to learn more about Recruit Craft Conclusion: The Enterprise Plan features in Recruit CRM along with the option to add them to Pro or Business subscriptions at an additional cost provide powerful tools to automate tasks, enhance reporting and streamline your recruiting workflow. b: The Recruit CRM mobile app lets you access and manage your Recruit CRM data directly from your iOS or Android phone. You can view candidates, contacts, companies, jobs, and deals, update hiring stages, and manage tasks, meetings, and notes while away from your computer. This article explains what you can do in the mobile app and how to navigate the key actions. Before you begin The Recruit CRM mobile app is available on both iOS and Android mobile devices. You must have an active Recruit CRM account to sign in and access your data in the app. Ensure you have an internet connection so the app can load your latest candidate, contact, company, job, and deal data. You can download our mobile apps from the following links: iPhone iPad Android After logging in, use the navigation in the app to access your main records. Open the section for candidates to view your complete candidate database. Open the sections for contacts, companies, jobs, and deals to see the full lists of those record types. ​ Open and work with a candidate’s detailed view: From the candidates list, tap on a candidate’s name to open their detailed record. Review the candidate’s details, including personal information and any other data visible on the record. Scroll within the candidate record to see which jobs they are assigned to and any related information. Change a candidate’s hiring stage: Open the candidate’s detailed view from the candidates list. Tap the hiring stage field and select the new hiring stage you want to move the candidate to. Submit to confirm the change so the new hiring stage is applied to the candidate. Send an email or call a candidate: Open the detailed view for the candidate you want to contact. Use the email option on the candidate record to send an email directly from the app. Use the call option on the candidate record to initiate a call from your phone. Use the VoIP calling feature, where available, on the candidate record. Add and view meetings, tasks, and notes on a candidate record: Open the candidate’s detailed view in the mobile app. Click on the 3 dots icon and you will be able to see options to add a meeting, task, note etc. Scroll to the meetings, tasks, and notes sections on the candidate record to view existing entries. View and manage jobs and candidate stages from the jobs view Navigate to the jobs section in the mobile app to see your list of jobs. Open a specific job to view the candidates associated with that job across different stages. Identify the candidate whose stage you want to change in the job pipeline. Tap the three dots on the right side of the candidate record within the job view. Choose the option to change the hiring stage and select the new stage for that candidate. Add remarks if the app provides a field for comments when changing the stage. ​ View Meetings and Tasks across your account: From the main navigation, switch to the Meetings tab to see all upcoming meetings. Review your upcoming meetings directly in this tab to keep track of your schedule. Switch to the Tasks tab to see all upcoming or incomplete tasks. Use these tabs to stay updated on what you need to do next in Recruit CRM. View notifications and chat with support Look at the top right of the app screen and tap the bell icon to open your notifications. Review all notifications listed there to stay updated on recent activity. ​ If you have any questions, open the in-app chat option from your mobile device. Send a message via chat to contact support directly from the mobile app. Conclusion: ​﻿The Recruit CRM mobile app gives you quick, on-the-go access to your candidates, jobs, tasks, meetings, and notifications so you can stay productive away from your desk. If you need more help using any part of the mobile app, reach out through the in-app chat from your phone. Can I mention teammates on any type of record?
b: What does this feature do? Need to quickly loop in a teammate on a record? Use mentions to notify them instantly and avoid back-and-forth. The Mention feature in Recruit CRM lets you tag teammates or teams directly in notes on the records. When you mention someone, they receive an in-app notification and an email notification with a direct link to the record where you added the note. If the note is added to a candidate from within a job , the notification also includes the Job Name and Company Name to provide additional context. Email notifications also include the job's primary contact. This helps recipients quickly understand which opportunity the note relates to before opening the record. When to use this feature? You can use this feature when: You want to quickly alert a teammate about an update on a candidate, company, contact, or job record. You need a direct link to a specific record included in an email notification. How to mention your teammate on a record? You can mention your teammates on any record (candidate/company/contact/job) by adding the "@" symbol in the Notes section. Your teammate will get an email notification with a link to the record you mentioned them on. You can see all "mentions" in the Notes section: Important Note: They might need to mark this email as "Not Spam" the first time so that all future "Mentions" show up right in the inbox. You can reply to this email directly to start an email thread with your teammate or click View Mention to open the related record. When the mention is added to a candidate from within a job, the opening line of the email body includes the candidate name, job name, company name, and the job's primary contact, making it easier to identify the context before opening the record. The email subject stays the same either way. If you are on the Business plan and above, you can also mention "Teams" even if you don't belong to that team. ​ However, please note that the tagged user will only be able to see the note if their role has 'View Everything' access: Editing a note that mentions someone: When you edit a note that already has a mention on it, everyone already mentioned continues to be notified by email only - there's no in-app notification for an edit. The email lets them know the mention was updated. If the note is a candidate note added from within a job, this email also includes the job name, company name, and primary contact for that job. If your edit mentions someone for the first time, they instead get the standard mention notification described earlier in this article, both in-app and by email, since it's a new mention for them. Troubleshooting Problem: The tagged user cannot see the note on the record. Likely cause The user role does not have “View Everything” access. What to check Confirm the user’s role and permissions, especially access to 'View Everything' on that record type. Resolution path The Account Owner should update the user’s role permissions or assign a role with “View everything” access so they can see the note. 🤔FAQs Can I mention teammates on any type of record? Yes. You can mention your teammates on any record, including candidates, companies, contacts, and jobs. Do mention notifications include job details? Yes. If a mention is added to a candidate note from within a job , both in-app and email notifications include the Job Name and Company Name so recipients can quickly understand which opportunity the note relates to. Which job is shown if a candidate is associated with multiple jobs? Notifications display the Job Name and Company Name of the job pipeline where the note was originally added. Other manually associated jobs are not included. Do email notifications include additional information? Yes. In addition to the candidate , job , and company names, email notifications also include the job's primary contact in the subject line. What happens when multiple candidates are mentioned from the same job? When mentions are created for multiple candidates within the same job, the notification groups them together under the same Job Name and Company Name , followed by the list or count of the affected candidates. Does this apply to notes created from the candidate profile? No. The additional job and company context is only included for notes added to a candidate from within a job . Notes created directly from the candidate profile continue to display the standard notification. Conclusion: Follow the steps above to mention individual users or teams, ensure emails reach their inboxes, and keep everyone aligned on key updates. Hope this helps! Happy Recruiting :) Related Articles Adding records in Recruit CRM Using Mentions to Notify Teammates in Recruit CRM Bulk Importing Records into Recruit CRM (New UI) Adding records in Recruit CRM (New UI) Scheduling Meetings in Recruit CRM (New UI)

t: Reports In Recruit CRM
s: This article will help you generate reports on your teammates, candidates, companies & jobs.
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
What are the different types of reports you can generate?
1. Account Overview Report
2. Team Performance Report
3. Candidate Lifecycle Report
4. Client Performance Report
5. Job Statistics Report
6. Time To Hire Report
b: What this feature does and when to use it? Recruit CRM's Reporting Suite provides a comprehensive set of reports to help you monitor performance, analyze business activity, and make informed, data-driven decisions. You can generate reports on candidates, companies, contacts, jobs, deals, clients, and teammates, giving you valuable insights into every stage of your recruitment process. Use this feature when: • You need an Account Overview report to understand overall business activity and performance. • You want a Team Performance report to monitor individual teammate or team performance. • You need a Candidate Lifecycle report to track candidate progression through your hiring pipeline. • You want Client Performance or Job Statistics reports to evaluate how your clients and jobs are performing. • You need reports such as Time to Hire , Deals by Teammates/Teams , or Deals by Revenue to measure hiring efficiency, pipeline health, and revenue performance. The Reporting Suite provides interactive charts, detailed tables, drill-down capabilities, and export options across all reports, making it easy to analyze your data from multiple perspectives. Reports are generated using the actual timestamps of activities and are adjusted according to each user's profile time zone, ensuring accurate reporting based on your account settings. ✅ When generating reports in Recruit CRM, it's crucial to remember the following key points: 1. Only the users on the Account Owner, Admin, and custom roles with relevant permissions will have access to the Reports section in Recruit CRM. 2. Recruit CRM's Reports feature is designed to run based on the actual timestamp of actions, taking into consideration the time zone specified in each user's Profile section. This means that if your team members are dispersed across various locations, there's a possibility of slight timing discrepancies in your reports. For instance, consider a scenario where a user with the time zone set to Australia generates a report for just one day. In this case, the results will reflect actions that occurred on that specific day in the Australian time zone. Consequently, it's entirely possible to observe actions performed by a user in New York on the preceding day, as it would have already been the current day in Australia due to the time zone difference. 📊 What are the different types of reports you can generate? 1. Account Overview Report 2. Team Performance Report 3. Candidate Lifecycle Report 4. Client Performance Report 5. Job Statistics Report 6. Time To Hire Report 7. Deals by Teammates/Team 8. Deals by Revenue 9. Target Report To access the available reports, navigate to the Reports section from the left-hand navigation panel. Here, you'll find the complete list of reports available to you based on your subscription plan and user permissions. From this page, you can generate, customize, save, and schedule reports to analyze different aspects of your recruitment process. ​ Please note that the users in the "Team Member" role will only be able to see their performance report on the Dashboard . ​ 🕘 How to schedule reports in Recruit CRM? With our "Schedule Report" feature, you can effortlessly automate the delivery of your saved reports to users at the frequency that suits your workflow. Learn how to schedule reports📈 Troubleshooting Problem: Report shows actions on unexpected dates Likely cause: Time zone differences between users. What to check : Confirm the time zone set in your user profile and the time zones of teammates whose actions appear in the report. Resolution: Interpret the report dates based on the time zone in your profile. Remember that actions from users in other time zones may appear on the previous or next day compared to their local time. Problem: A user cannot access the reports section Likely cause: Insufficient role or permissions. What to check : Verify whether the user is an account owner, admin, or has a custom role with relevant permissions. Resolution : Update the user’s role or permissions so they meet the requirement for accessing the reports section, or have an Admin run and share the reports instead. Problem: Team member cannot see all reports Likely cause: Role limitation for team members. What to check: Confirm that the user is assigned the team member role. Resolution: Team members can only see their team performance report on the dashboard. For broader reporting access, consider changing their role or having an admin share required reports. Problem: Scheduled reports are not useful due to timing discrepancies Likely cause : Scheduled time does not align with relevant time zones. What to check: Review when the scheduled report is delivered and how the report period aligns with users’ profile time zones. Resolution: Adjust the scheduling frequency or timing to better match the working hours and time zones of the users who receive the report. FAQs Q1: Which roles can access the reports section in Recruit CRM? Only users in the account owner, admin, and custom roles with relevant permissions can access the reports section. Q2: What reports can Team Members see? Users in the team member role can only see their team performance report on the dashboard. Q3: How do time zones affect my reports? Reports run based on the actual timestamps of actions, using the time zone specified in each user’s profile. If users are in different locations, actions may appear on different calendar days depending on each user’s time zone. Q4: Can I automate report delivery? Yes. With the scheduled report feature, you can automate the delivery of your saved reports to users at the frequency that suits your workflow. Conclusion Using the reports feature in Recruit CRM, you can generate detailed insights on candidates, clients, jobs, teammates, and deals, and automate report delivery to fit your workflow. If you need further help interpreting report data or configuring access, contact the support team for additional guidance. t: Requesting Updated Candidate Profiles
s: Our "Request Profile Update" feature will help you get updated resumes/profiles directly from a candidate in a few clicks.
h: What this feature does and when to use it?
How to request updated profiles from candidates?
1. From the Candidate Details page
2. From the Candidates List page
How to edit the Profile Update Request email template?
How to customize the Profile Update Request form?
Troubleshooting
Problem: The profile update link doesn't work.
b: What this feature does and when to use it? The Request Updated Profile feature allows you to send candidates a secure link where they can update their profile information and upload their latest resume. Once submitted, the updated information is automatically reflected in Recruit CRM. This feature is useful when you want to: Request an updated resume from a candidate. Keep candidate records up to date. Send profile update requests to one or multiple candidates. How to request updated profiles from candidates? You can send profile update requests from either the Candidate Details page or the Candidates List page. 1. From the Candidate Details page Use this option to request an updated profile from a single candidate. Open the required Candidate profile and click the Email "Profile update request" button. An email containing a secure profile update link is sent to the candidate. Once the candidate submits the form, their updated information is automatically reflected in Recruit CRM. 2. From the Candidates List page Use this option to request updated profiles from multiple candidates at once. Navigate to the Candidates list and select the required candidates. Click Request Updated Profile . An individual email containing the profile update link is sent to each selected candidate. Please note: Each recipient receives a separate email, ensuring the request appears as a personal email. The profile update link expires after the candidate submits the form. How to edit the Profile Update Request email template? You can customize the email sent to candidates when requesting profile updates. Navigate to Mailbox → Standard Email Templates . Click the Edit (pencil) icon beside the Request Updated Profile email template. Modify the template as required and save your changes. Please note: Do not create a new template for profile update requests. The Request Updated Profile button only works with the default email template. Do not remove the {URL} placeholder, as it generates the secure profile update link. How to customize the Profile Update Request form? Navigate to Admin Settings → Profile Update Form Settings . Under the General Page Settings tab, edit the Page Title, button labels, and link labels as required. Open the Profile Update Form Field Settings tab to customize the form fields. Here, you can edit field labels, show or hide fields, and mark specific fields as required. You can also configure one or more default languages for the Profile Update form. Candidates must select a proficiency level for each default language displayed. If no default languages are configured, candidates can add their own languages and specify the proficiency level for each. Troubleshooting Problem: The profile update link doesn't work. Likely Cause: The link has already been used. What to Check: Confirm whether the candidate has already submitted the Profile Update form. Resolution: Send a new profile update request to generate a fresh link. Problem: The required fields aren't appearing on the Profile Update form. Likely Cause: The fields haven't been enabled in the Profile Update Form Settings. What to Check: Review the field visibility and required field settings. Resolution: Enable the required fields and save your changes. FAQs What happens after a candidate submits the Profile Update form? The submitted information is automatically updated in Recruit CRM. Conclusion: The Request Updated Profile feature makes it easy to keep candidate records accurate by allowing candidates to securely update their information and upload their latest resumes. Combined with customizable email templates and profile update forms, it provides a seamless experience for both recruiters and candidates. t: Requesting Updated Candidate Profiles (New UI)
s: Our "Request Profile Update" feature will help you get updated resumes/profiles directly from a candidate in a few clicks.
h: What this feature does & when to use it?
Before you begin
Step-by-step instructions

b: What this feature does & when to use it? The Profile Update Request feature in Recruit CRM lets you send candidates an email containing a secure link to a form where they can update their details and CV. Once they submit the form, their information is updated in your Recruit CRM database in real time. You can use this feature: When you want to refresh outdated candidate information or request an updated CV. When you need multiple candidates to update their profiles at once. Before you begin Please note: You must have access to candidate records in Recruit CRM. Ensure your Mailbox is connected so emails can be sent from Recruit CRM. Please note that the profile update link expires after the candidate submits their updated profile. Step-by-step instructions 1. Request an updated profile from a candidate’s detail page From the candidate’s details page, you can request an updated profile directly. Navigate to a candidate's profile. On the candidate’s profile, click the Request Updated Profile button as shown in the image. ​ Once you click on it, the system triggers an email to be sent to the candidate with a URL link. This URL will lead the candidate to the profile update request form that they can fill in to submit their updated details. ​ The details then directly get updated in your system in real-time. 2. Request updated profiles for multiple candidates from the Candidates List page You can send an email to multiple candidates at the same time with the link to update profiles. 1. Navigate to the Candidates List page. 2. Select the candidates whose data you want to update. 3. Click on the Request Updated Profile option at the top. 4. This will trigger an email to all the selected candidates. Note: It's worth noting that each person in the To section is sent as an individual email thread so that the receiver perceives it as a personal message. The link will expire after the candidate submits the updated profile. Edit the email template for requesting updated profiles Click on the Mailbox section. Scroll down to find the Standard Email Templates button. Click on the pencil icon on the right side of the template to edit the template. Please Note: 1. Do not create a new template for the same as the URL for the profile update request will only be generated using the "Request Updated Profile" button and the standard email (which can be edited). 2. Do not remove {URL} from the standard email template body as it is used to trigger some pre-coded actions. You may edit the rest of the email content (subject line, message text, etc.) to match your tone and branding. Customize the profile update request form You can customize the labels and fields on the form and also make certain fields mandatory as well. Navigate to the Admin Settings . Click on Profile Update Form Settings . ​ Within the General Page Settings tab, click on the Edit button to edit the labels of buttons and links. ​ You can modify the page title as well. Now, switch to the Profile Update Form Field Settings tab. Within this tab, you can edit the label of the fields. Choose the fields to make them visible on the form by turning the toggle on. You can also make certain fields required by enabling the checkbox. You also have the ability to add language and the respective proficiency level to the form. You can add one or multiple default languages to the form by updating the field's value: ​ You can add languages and proficiency levels from here. ​ And click on Save . Once you add it to the form, candidates will have to define a proficiency level for the default languages added. They can also edit the proficiency level for the language already added to their profile in your database. Further, in case there are no default languages added to the form, then candidates can add multiple languages and define the proficiency level for each of them. View candidates who updated their profile 1. Go to the Candidates List page. 2. Click on the Add Filters option. 3. Search for the filter called Profile Updated by Candidate On . 4. Select the date or time range you want. 5. Click on Apply . You will now see all candidates who updated their profile during the selected period. Troubleshooting Problem: Candidate says the link in the email no longer works. Likely cause: The candidate has already submitted their updated profile, and the link has expired. What to check: Confirm whether the candidate’s record shows recent updates. Resolution path: If more changes are needed, send a new Request Updated Profile email from the candidate’s detail page or update their record manually. Problem: Certain fields never appear on the candidate’s update form. Likely cause: The fields are not set to visible in the Profile Update Form Field Settings . What to check: Go to Admin Settings → Profile Update Form Settings → Profile Update Form Field Settings and check the visibility toggles. Resolution path: Turn the relevant field toggles on and save your changes. FAQs Who can configure the profile update form fields and labels? Typically, users with access to Admin Settings (such as admins or account owners) can configure the Profile Update Form Settings , including labels, visibility, and required fields. How personal are the emails when sending to multiple candidates? When you send profile update requests from the Candidates List page, each person in the To section receives an individual email thread, so the email appears as a personal email. Conclusion: Using the Profile Update Request feature in Recruit CRM, you can quickly refresh candidate data, request updated CVs, and keep your database accurate with minimal manual effort. Configure the email and form once, and then use individual or bulk requests to maintain up-to-date profiles. 📹 Video tutorial on how the Profile Update feature works within Recruit CRM ​ Related Articles Requesting Updated Candidate Profiles Emailing Candidates & Contacts (New UI) Social Profile Links - Candidates/Companies/Contacts(New UI) AI Candidate Summary Generator (New UI) Passcode for public pages (New UI)

s: Create clean, professional, and client-ready resumes in seconds.

From the Resume Preview

b: The Resume Formatting Agent helps you automatically generate well-structured resumes using AI, without needing to manually format them. Once you define your preferred layout and style, every resume follows the same consistent format, making your submissions more polished and efficient. Please note Resume generation works for one candidate at a time (bulk generation is not supported). The Resume Formatting Agent is available across supported plans with plan-specific generation limits. It runs on the gpt-oss-120b (Cerebras) model. Free and Pro users can generate up to 5 resumes per user. The 5-resume limit applies only to new resume generations. Editing an already generated resume does not count toward this limit. AI edits consume 0.5 Recruit CRM credits per edit. Manual edits and restoring previous versions do not consume credits. ✨ How it works The Resume Formatting Agent helps you quickly create formatted resumes with AI. You can set your preferred style and structure using presets or custom instructions, and the system will automatically apply this format every time a resume is generated using the Agent. Open " Admin Settings " and access the " Resume Formatting Settings ". ​ Access the "Resume Formatting Agent" from the panel on the right. ​ Select one of the available presets , which provide a predefined structure and style for the resume. Alternatively, you can create your own format by adding custom instructions in the Instruction box. You can also choose a preset and modify its instructions to better match your requirements. The available presets include: • Forest Minimal – Clean, minimal, and modern; suitable for general recruitment across most industries • Executive Prestige – Dramatic and prestigious; ideal for executive search and board-level roles • Bold Editorial – Bold and typographic; best suited for senior, creative, or editorial roles ​ Configure additional options to control how the resume is generated and what information it includes. Choose Custom Field to Save Resume You can decide where the generated resume will be saved by selecting a File type custom field . You can either choose an existing file field or create a new one directly from here. A File type custom field must be selected to save generated resumes. If no field is selected, you will be prompted to choose or create one before proceeding. ​ If a resume already exists in the selected field, you will have the option to replace it. When a resume is replaced, the older version is automatically moved to the Files section to help prevent data loss. ​ Custom Fields to include in Formatted Resume You can include additional candidate information in the resume by selecting up to 10 default or custom candidate fields you want to display. You can also include Candidate Owner Name, Email, and Phone number. Note: All candidate custom field types are supported except File and Entity fields. Long Text fields support content up to 1000 characters. ​ Information used to generate the formatted resume: The information provided to the AI depends on whether the candidate has an existing resume: If the candidate has a resume: The AI uses the resume text along with the 10 fields selected in Resume Formatting Settings . These can include default fields, custom fields, and Candidate Owner Name, Email, and Phone number. If the candidate does not have a resume, the AI uses the candidate's basic details and work history , along with the 10 fields selected in Resume Formatting Settings, which may include: Basic details: First Name, Last Name, Email, Contact Number, Position, Last Organisation Professional information: Summary, Qualification, Specialization, Work Experience, Current Salary, Salary Expectation, Notice Period, Willingness to Relocate Location and address: Locality, City, State, Country, and Address Skills and languages: Skills and Language Skills Personal details: Gender, Age, and Date of Birth Social profiles: LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter, GitHub, and Xing Profile information: Profile Picture and Resume Filename Only the information provided to the AI during generation is available for use when making AI edits to the generated resume. Include your company logo You can choose to include your company logo in the resume. The logo is fetched from your Public Job Page settings : If a logo is not available or the option is disabled, the resume will automatically adjust and be generated without branding. ​ Text Redaction on Resume You can choose to hide sensitive candidate details such as Phone, Email and LinkedIn. These selected fields will be automatically excluded from the resume. Tip: If you want to hide additional details (such as name or location), you can mention this in your instructions. ​ ​ Click Preview to see how the resume will look. It is recommended to review the preview at least once before saving to ensure the formatting and layout appear as expected. ​ Click "Save Instructions" to apply your configuration. Once saved, the same format is used whenever you generate a resume for any candidate. ​ Please Note The AI may not always follow instructions perfectly and can sometimes produce slightly inconsistent results. We recommend previewing the generated resume and refining instructions if needed. ​ If EEO settings are enabled, sensitive information such as Age, Gender, and Ethnicity will automatically be excluded from the formatted resume. You can generate AI Formatted Resumes from multiple places such as: From the Candidate Profile Navigate to the Generate Resume with Agent option at the top of the candidate’s details page. If the option is not visible among the default actions, click on the three dots (⋯) and select Generate Resume with Agent from the list ​ From the Resume Preview On the Candidate List page, click on the candidate’s resume that you want to generate using the agent. Once the resume preview panel opens, click Generate Resume with Agent from the bottom of the preview window. ​ ​ Edit a Generated Resume Once a resume is generated, you can edit it directly from the preview using AI instructions, voice commands, or manual edits. Edit using AI Enter a natural-language instruction to make changes to the resume, such as rewriting the summary, making content more concise, or improving a section. Edit manually Use the built-in rich text editor to make direct changes to the resume. Please note: Manual edits do not consume credits or count toward the AI edit limit and can be combined with AI edits. Edit using voice Use voice input to give instructions to the AI Editor. Your voice instruction is converted to text and processed as an AI edit. Please note: AI edit instructions must contain between 15 and 500 characters . Edit History Each successful AI edit is added to Edit History during the current editing session. You can view previous AI instructions, restore a previous version, and continue editing from the restored version. You can make up to 15 AI edits per session . Restoring a previous version does not consume credits. Please note: Edit History is available only during the current editing session. Save your changes Click Save Changes to save your edits. The updated resume replaces the existing version in the configured custom field, while the previous version is moved to the Files section. You can also download the current version during the editing session without saving it. AI edit credits Each AI edit consumes 0.5 Recruit CRM credits . AI edits: 0.5 credits per edit Manual edits: No credits Restoring a previous version: No credits If the required candidate information wasn't provided during generation, you can include it directly in your edit instruction. If a valid instruction is processed but the required information is unavailable, the credit is still consumed. If you don't have enough credits, the AI edit won't be processed, and no credits will be deducted. You'll see an Insufficient Credits message with an option to purchase additional credits. Please note: AI editing is available only during the active editing session after generating a resume. Once you save or discard the changes and close the preview, you must generate a new resume to edit it again. 🧩 Presets available The agent provides ready-made resume styles to help you get started: • Forest Minimal : Clean and modern ​ • Bold Editorial : Bold and executive ​ • Executive Prestige : Premium and high-impact ​ Selecting a preset automatically fills in the instruction field, which you can further edit if needed.
